Name: Aaron Gibbs
Intro description:
Hi, I'm Aaron. I'm a Wealth Manager with Palladian Asset Management based in Richmond, Virginia. I help clients with retirement planning, investment management, income planning, individual retirement accounts, company retirement accounts, and general investing.

I believe strong planning starts with listening. Once I understand what clients want to accomplish, I help build strategies tailored to their goals and revisit those goals throughout the relationship.
Full description:
Aaron Gibbs is a Wealth Manager with 18 years of experience in financial services. He earned a degree in Managerial Economics from Hampden-Sydney College and has worked for the Federal Reserve Bank, a Fortune 500 company, and several wealth management businesses.

Aaron works with a wide range of clients, including doctors, lawyers, business owners, and hardworking families. His work often centers on retirement planning, investment management, income planning, individual retirement accounts, company retirement accounts, and general investing.

Outside of work, Aaron has coached basketball for Upward and RockIt Sports. He has also been involved with Rotary Club. Much of his time now is spent supporting his three children and their busy schedules.

Name: Aaron Peloquin
Intro description: Hello there! 👋🏼 I’m Aaron, a CERTIFIED FINANCIAL PLANNER™ and CPA with more than 20 years of experience in the financial services industry - including over 8 years as a Wealth Advisor. I specialize in helping clients plan for financial independence through comprehensive, tax-efficient wealth strategies built around their unique values, goals, and life mission. My past experience as a consultant and risk management professional provided the foundation for the advisor that I am today. Those opportunities provided me with a broad perspective of the financial industry and helped to develop the skills necessary to analyze and assess my clients' financial goals and their needs as they seek financial independence.
Full description:
Aaron specializes in helping clients plan for financial independence through comprehensive, tax-efficient wealth strategies built around each client’s unique values, goals, and life mission. Aaron works with his clients to build a personalized wealth plan, by developing a trusting relationship through actively listening and understanding each client’s goals, investing experiences, and risks and fears. With over 25 years of experience in the financial services industry, Aaron understands the complexities involved in helping clients navigate their financial goals including investments, taxes, risk management, and giving and legacy strategies.

Prior to becoming a financial advisor, Aaron worked as a consultant with a leading global CPA and consulting firm, helping financial services companies improve operations and compliance risk management. He later led operational risk teams at local firms and a Minneapolis hedge fund, deepening his interest in investing and the markets. This experience built the foundation for his advisory work, giving him a broad industry perspective and the ability to assess clients’ goals as they pursue financial independence. Today, Aaron's team serves employees with stock compensation at private and public companies, as well as consultants and business owners. They also guide individuals nearing or in retirement, with expertise in stock compensation planning, tax mitigation, retirement planning, and investment management.

Name: Aaron Wiegman
Intro description: Hello there 👋🏼 I'm Aaron, and I have over 20 years of experience as a financial advisor. My expertise lies in assisting clients with prioritizing their financial plans. I achieve this by effectively managing cash flow, optimizing savings, tracking expenses, maximizing earnings, allocating portfolios, ensuring tax efficiency, and implementing risk management strategies. By developing a comprehensive game plan that aligns with the client's values and goals, I foster open communication and strive to present complex concepts in a clear and understandable manner. My ultimate objective is to maintain an approachable practice and meet clients wherever they may be on their financial journey.
Full description:
Aaron, a proud Wisconsin native, graduated from Wisconsin Lutheran College in 2000 with a Bachelor's degree in business administration. He kick-started his career in the operations and trading department of a small local broker-dealer. Afterward, he made the move to San Diego, and since then, he has been actively involved in the financial industry. Driven by his passion for continuous growth, Aaron obtained his CERTIFIED FINANCIAL PLANNING™ (CFP®) designation in 2011, complementing his securities licensing with insurance expertise. Prior to joining Savvy, he was a Senior Lead Wealth Advisor at a prominent San Diego RIA. Currently, Aaron resides in the Del Mar area of San Diego alongside his girlfriend and beloved companion, Buddy, who happens to be his dog.

While remaining a devoted supporter of his hometown teams—the Packers, Bucks, Brewers, and Badgers—Aaron has shifted his focus from basketball to pickleball as his preferred active pursuit. Additionally, he has recently embraced the exhilarating journey of learning to box.

Name: Albert Pinedo
Intro description:
Hi 👋🏼 I'm Albert. I advise corporate executives, entrepreneurs, and wealth-builders to shift from the noise of managing financial complexity to a state of total clarity, backed by a custom blueprint deliberately aligned with what matters most in life.

At our practice, we believe building wealth is just the baseline. Many professionals and business owners reach a threshold where they’ve achieved incredible career milestones, yet find a more profound question emerging: How do I align these resources to live with deep intentionality? We step in as dedicated partners at that exact crossroad, guiding our clients as they streamline their financial moving pieces so they can focus on the experiences, people, and pursuits that give life true meaning.

Together, we transform wealth from a complex web of numbers into a protective, highly optimized engine to give you the ultimate freedom to accomplish what really matters today and secure your legacy for tomorrow.
Full description:
My trajectory in wealth management bridges rigorous institutional experience with an independent, entrepreneurial drive. Spanning more than two decades in global financial markets, I have dedicated my career to decoding complex economic landscapes for professionals, multi-generational families, and business owners.

I am a graduate of the Lubar College of Business at the University of Wisconsin-Milwaukee, and I hold the Certified Private Wealth Advisor® (CPWA®) designation, an advanced credential completed through the Yale University School of Management. The CPWA® curriculum requires a multidisciplinary mastery of advanced wealth management disciplines, specifically focusing on complex tax mitigation, asset protection, estate preservation, and legacy structures. This specialized training allows me to look at wealth through a wide-angle lens, protecting clients against concentrated market risks, minimizing structural tax drag, and smoothing the transition of family assets. Prior to aligning with Savvy, I successfully founded and scaled my own independent advisory firm, Marketwise Asset Management, establishing a deep-seated commitment to providing institutional-grade portfolio oversight delivered through a warm, deeply individualized client experience fluent in both domestic and international dynamics.

Name: Alex Barnes
Intro description: Hello! 👋 I’m Alex, a dedicated financial advisor with a passion for helping clients achieve their financial dreams through personalized, tax-optimized strategies. With a background in banking and years of experience in financial planning, I bring a unique blend of expertise and empathy to my work, focusing on income planning and tax efficiency to guide clients toward their goals. My journey to becoming a financial advisor was driven by a desire to make a meaningful impact, building trusted relationships that empower pre-retirees to plan confidently for their future. Outside of work, you can find me hitting the golf course, playing pickup basketball, or getting in a good workout. Family time is especially important to me, and I love nothing more than cheering on my daughter at her soccer games and my son on his football team. On weekends, you can often find me outside by the grill, experimenting with new BBQ techniques and smoking meat for friends and family.
Full description:
With a foundation of experience in banking and a deep passion for personalized financial guidance, Alex has dedicated his career to helping pre-retirees achieve their dreams through thoughtful, tax-optimized strategies. His expertise in income planning and tax efficiency, paired with advanced financial tools, allows him to craft tailored plans that align with each client’s unique goals. What drives Alex is building meaningful relationships and celebrating the joy of seeing clients gain confidence in their financial future.

Alex claims the most rewarding part of his work is witnessing the relief and excitement clients feel when they achieve a milestone they’ve planned together—whether it’s preparing for a secure retirement, funding a dream purchase, or creating a legacy for their loved ones. Every step of the journey reinforces his commitment to providing clear, strategic support that makes a real difference. His goal is simple, to help clients keep more of what they earn and invest with purpose, so they can live the life they envision.

Outside of work, Alex enjoys staying active, whether that’s hitting the golf course, playing pickup basketball, or getting in a good workout. Family time is especially important, and he loves nothing more than cheering on his daughter at her soccer games and his son on his football team. On weekends, you can often find Alex outside by the grill, experimenting with new BBQ techniques and smoking meat for friends and family.

Name: Alex Duncan
Intro description:
Hi 👋 I'm Alex. Before becoming a financial advisor, I spent 15 years working in medical device sales and leadership. Today, I help medical device and pharmaceutical professionals navigate many of the same financial decisions I encountered during my own career.

My work centers on comprehensive financial planning, investment management, and stock-based compensation, including RSUs, stock options, and ESPPs. I understand how variable income, taxes, company stock, and career decisions can intersect. At Duncan Wealth Management, I help clients bring those pieces together into a flexible financial plan that can evolve as their careers and priorities change.
Full description:
Alex Duncan took an unconventional path to wealth management. After earning his degree in economics with the intention of entering the industry, his career instead led him into medical device sales and leadership, where he spent 15 years.

Alex began at Bausch + Lomb as a phone sales representative and worked his way up to national account manager. He later joined Sight Sciences during its earlier stages and was with the company through its IPO. Along the way, he experienced many of the compensation opportunities and decisions that medical device and pharmaceutical professionals encounter, including participating in an employee stock purchase plan, receiving RSUs, and exercising stock options.

Those experiences also showed Alex how complicated equity compensation can become when taxes, timing, diversification, and long-term financial goals are considered together. His own financial decisions ultimately helped shape the work he does today.

Four years ago, Alex transitioned into wealth management and launched Duncan Wealth Management. He now works primarily with medical device and pharmaceutical professionals, from sales representatives to senior executives, helping them understand how their compensation fits into their broader financial lives.

As a CERTIFIED FINANCIAL PLANNER® professional, Alex focuses on comprehensive financial planning, investment management, early retirement planning, and stock-based compensation. His firsthand industry experience gives him an understanding of the career paths, variable compensation structures, and financial decisions his clients regularly face.

Name: Allen Buckley
Intro description: Hi, I’m Allen Buckley. I work with individuals and families to bring clarity to complex financial decisions by aligning investment strategy with thoughtful planning. With over 20 years of experience, I focus on getting to know each client personally so we can organize their financial life and move forward with clear direction.
Full description:
Allen Buckley has over two decades of experience in finance serving the unique needs of high net-worth and ultra high net-worth families. As a Certified Financial Planner™, he specializes in helping clients achieve their financial goals, tailored to their individual circumstances and aspirations.

As a former Vice President in personal financial management at one of the world’s leading investment banks, Allen gained invaluable insights into managing wealth for discerning clients. During his tenure at Goldman Sachs, Allen worked with individual clients and families, helped them navigate complex financial landscapes and tailored financial solutions to their specific needs.

Beyond his professional pursuits, Allen finds joy in his family life alongside his wife, Crystal, and their children, Ella, Ava, and Luke. Together, they call Thompson’s Station, TN home and enjoy boating and various outdoor activities. His dedication to family, clients and his community define his career as a trusted advisor.

Name: Anderson Wozny
Intro description: Hi there 👋🏼 I’m Anderson, a financial advisor specializing in retirement planning, investment strategy, and helping clients avoid surprises like taxes, risks, or shortfalls in their financial plans. With over 30 years of industry experience, I prioritize listening carefully, asking the right questions, and guiding my clients to stay focused on what truly matters. My approach isn’t about impressing with complexity, instead, I focus on what’s effective, practical, and tailored to the unique needs of each client.‍

Name: Andrea Nolan
Intro description: My name is Andrea Nolan, and I have served as a financial advisor to families and businesses since 1998. I began my career at Merrill Lynch and in 2008 I joined Ancora West to help build their wealth advisory practice. I work with high-net-worth and ultra-high-net-worth clients from all walks of life to help create portfolios that last a lifetime. I cultivate relationships with a “client-first” approach, centered on consistent communication and education about the decisions that impact their financial futures. It goes without saying that confidentiality is paramount, but I happen to take pride in building that trust.
Full description:
Andrea Nolan loves elevating people. As a former collegiate basketball player at Cal Berkley and UNLV, she was no stranger to effectively communicating in high-pressure situations and coming through for her team members. As a financial advisor for 27 years, she’s held the same standard of communication and coming through for her clients.

Her areas of expertise include portfolio management, tax optimization, and business development. Through each area and interaction, Andrea is keen on making the client experience less stressful and complicated. She wants all of her clients to feel comfortable and educated about their investments.

Beyond her financial interests, Andrea is an avid golfer and tennis player. If you’ve been on a video call with Andrea, you may also catch a glimpse of her two adorable cats, “Chai” and “Charlie.”

Name: Andrew N George, Sr
Intro description:
Hi 👋🏼 I’m Andrew. I’m a financial advisor based in Starkville, Mississippi, with 20 years of experience helping individuals and families navigate important financial decisions.

Financial planning has been part of my life for as long as I can remember. My father was an early CFP® professional in Mississippi, and after law school, I joined him in practice. Seeing the relationships he built with families shaped how I approach my own work today.

I combine comprehensive financial planning, investment management, retirement planning, and estate and legacy considerations with behavioral investment counseling. My goal is to help clients bring structure to complex decisions, stay disciplined through changing markets, and build a thoughtful financial plan around what matters most to them.
Full description:
Andrew George brings 20 years of financial services experience to his work with individuals and families. His connection to financial planning began early, inspired in part by his father, who was an early CFP® professional in Mississippi. This experience gave Andrew a firsthand perspective on the role a financial advisor can play in helping families make thoughtful financial decisions throughout different stages of life.

Andrew attended the University of Mississippi, where he earned a Bachelor of Business Administration in Managerial Finance with an emphasis in Investment Analysis. After beginning his career in life insurance and financial planning, he returned to Ole Miss to earn his Juris Doctor degree. While in law school, he received the Dean’s Distinguished Service Award and served as Attorney General for the Law School Student Body.

After completing his law degree in 2008, Andrew worked alongside his father in a Registered Investment Advisory practice before continuing his career in financial services. His legal education gives him an additional perspective when reviewing estate, tax, business succession, and wealth-transfer considerations and coordinating with clients’ attorneys and tax professionals.

Andrew’s work centers on long-term relationships. He serves professionals, business owners, retirees, and families with complex financial lives who want their planning, investments, retirement strategy, and legacy considerations viewed together rather than separately. He also incorporates behavioral investment counseling into his work, helping clients remain disciplined when markets and personal circumstances change.

Outside of his professional work, Andrew has served as an Elder and as President of the Christian Preschool Board of Directors at First Presbyterian Church Starkville. He is an Eagle Scout and has volunteered with the Boy Scouts of America. He has also served his local community through homeowner association and volunteer fire district board roles.

Andrew and his wife, Stacey, are the parents of twins, Drew and Katie Clay.

Name: Angelique Ayala
Intro description:
Hello 👋🏼 I’m Angelique. I help individuals and families make confident, informed financial decisions by simplifying complex topics and providing clear, actionable guidance. From retirement income and investment planning to estate, insurance, and long-term care strategies, I focus on aligning your finances with your goals and values.

I take an educational, collaborative approach, ensuring clients understand their options and can make intentional decisions about their financial future. My mission is to empower you to take ownership of your plan, whether you’re preparing for retirement, funding education, or protecting your loved ones.
Full description:
Angelique Ayala is a comprehensive financial planner dedicated to helping individuals and families make confident, informed financial decisions. She believes that preparing for the next step in life, whether it’s retirement, college planning, or protecting loved ones, shouldn’t feel overwhelming. Through a combination of experience, professionalism, and empathy, Angelique helps her clients build strategies that align with their goals, values, and long-term vision.

Angelique works closely with clients to simplify complex financial topics, providing education and clarity every step of the way. Her planning approach covers a wide range of needs, including retirement and investment planning, estate and insurance strategies, and long-term care considerations. She takes pride in empowering clients to take ownership of their financial future and feel confident in the path ahead.

A graduate of George Mason University with a degree in Finance and a minor in Economics, Angelique entered the financial planning profession after witnessing firsthand how a lack of financial education can affect families. That experience continues to drive her mission to make financial guidance accessible, understandable, and actionable.

Originally from Northern Virginia, Angelique lives in Centreville with her dog Tigre. Outside of work, she enjoys spending time outdoors, staying active, traveling, and exploring new cultures with friends and family.

Name: Arynton Hardy
Intro description: Hello there 👋🏼 I’m Arynton Hardy, a Wealth Manager, Licensed Advisor, and Entrepreneur specializing in financial planning for clients with unique income streams. My passion lies in creating personalized plans tailored to their specific circumstances, helping them navigate the intricacies of their financial situations, and ultimately achieving their goals.

Name: Ashley Crane
Intro description:
Hi, I’m Ashley. I’m a financial advisor based in Raleigh, North Carolina, with 17 years of experience helping individuals, couples, retirees, women, divorcees, and small business owners organize their financial lives.

My work focuses on retirement planning, tax-aware decision-making, risk management, and financial planning. I take the time to listen, understand what matters to each client, and explain complex topics in clear, easy-to-understand terms. Together, we build a practical plan that supports their needs through life’s transitions.
Full description:
Ashley Crane is a North Carolina native who has spent her life building strong connections within the communities she calls home. She grew up in a small town north of Greensboro and attended North Carolina State University in Raleigh, where she studied Business Management with concentrations in marketing and finance.

Ashley began her career in banking before moving into small business venture capital. While working with business owners, she saw how personal financial instability could affect their ability to pursue professional goals. Those experiences, along with conversations with her own financial advisor, inspired her to enter financial planning.

After seven years in the financial industry, Ashley became a financial advisor at age 28. Today, she helps clients work through retirement decisions, tax-aware income distribution, military retiree benefits, divorce transitions, cash flow management, estate protection, and long-term planning.

Ashley lives in Garner, North Carolina, with her husband and their rescue boxer. She is active in her community and attends Amelia Christian Church in Clayton. Outside of work, she enjoys traveling with her husband, playing and teaching piano, gardening, and searching for ice cream shops throughout rural North Carolina. She is also a proud supporter of the NC State Wolfpack and the Carolina Hurricanes.

Name: Berkely Arrants
Intro description:
Hello 👋🏼 I’m Berkely. I help individuals, families, and business owners bring clarity and confidence to their financial lives through thoughtful, strategic planning. As the Founder of Horizon Advisory Group, I specialize in guiding clients through major life and business transitions, from growing and exiting a company to navigating retirement, divorce, or loss of a loved one.

My approach is rooted in education and empowerment. I take complex financial topics and make them simple and actionable, so clients can make informed decisions with confidence. Whether I’m designing a comprehensive financial plan, developing a business succession strategy, or creating a personalized retirement income plan, my goal is always the same: to help people move forward with purpose and peace of mind.
Full description:
Berkely Arrants is the Founder of Horizon Advisory Group, LLC, a Houston based personal and business financial planning firm. Her passion for helping people, and her expertise in taking complex situations and making them simple, led her to become a financial planner. Berkely holds the designations of Certified Financial Planner®, Certified Investment Management Analyst®, and Certified Retirement Planning Counselor®.

Berkely specializes in closely held and family business planning, including transition, employee retention, executive benefits, owner retirement, valuation, and estate planning. She also focuses on personal financial planning, helping owners exit their businesses strategically.

On the personal financial side, through the use of comprehensive financial planning, Berkely helps her clients establish and refine their goals by listening carefully to what is important to them now and in the future. She then designs a strategic, personalized path towards accomplishing their unique objectives.

Berkely has been involved in a number of Boards over the years including Volunteers in Medicine, the First Presbyterian Day School, The Houston Children’s Chorus, The University of Pennsylvania Alumni Club of Houston, and she was an Elder at First Presbyterian Church in Hilton Head.

Outside of work, Berkely is devoted to her family and her community. She has been married to Wayne for 32 years and has two children Tucker and Devin. She practices yoga regularly and loves to travel and spend time outdoors.

Name: Brad Morgan
Intro description: Hi there! 👋🏼 I'm Brad, a former Procter & Gamble employee turned financial advisor.  With a focus on tax planning, I've been a trusted advisor for the P&G community for over ten years.  I pride myself on building lasting relationships with my clients, understanding their needs, and providing tailored solutions. I define success as taking the client relationship to a level of complete trust and confidence.
Full description:
Brad is a CERTIFIED FINANCIAL PLANNER™ who specializes in assisting Procter & Gamble (P&G) employees and retirees with their financial planning needs. With expertise in tax strategies, charitable giving, stock options, estate planning, and income management, Brad provides tailored guidance to help clients navigate the complexities of their compensation packages. His unique perspective as a former P&G employee and a member of a multi-generational P&G family enables him to empathize with clients’ challenges and decisions. He holds both a bachelor's and a master's degree in Mechanical Engineering from the University of Tennessee, where he graduated with honors. Brad met his wife, Jenny, at P&G, where she worked in marketing for 12 years. They live in Madeira, OH, with their four children and two dogs.

Outside of work, Brad and Jenny are passionate cyclists and enjoy traveling with their family. They also love skiing—snow in winter and water in summer—and actively participate in their local church, Crossroads. This blend of personal and professional experience makes Brad a trusted resource for P&G employees seeking to secure their financial futures.

Name: Brandon Barber
Intro description: With over 13 years of sales and consulting experience in the 401(k) and HR Technology world, I help retirement plan sponsors and employees navigate the complexities associated with retirement plans.
Full description:
Straight out of Texas State University, Brandon spent over seven years at ADP helping hundreds of business owners streamline their payroll and 401(k) administration processes. During that time, Brandon realized he wanted to revolutionize how plan sponsors and employees interact with their retirement plans.

His subsequent role at Paycor would allow him to help HR and Finance leaders identify inefficiencies and design the right solutions for employer-sponsored retirement plans. With a passion for positively impacting the financial health of those he works with, Brandon joined Savvy to help plan sponsors and employees decrease the burden of understanding and optimizing benefits.

Outside of his passion for 401(k) plans, Brandon loves spending time outdoors with his family, advocating for foster care, and finding ways to give back to his local church. He also loves to dance. So much in fact that he met his wife two-stepping in Austin!

Name: Brandon Mull
Intro description:
I’m Brandon, Founder of Marathon Wealth Advisors. I help individuals and families turn complex financial decisions into clear, confident plans built for the long run. With nearly two decades of experience in wealth management and investment strategy, and both the CFA® and CFP® designations, I bring a disciplined, thoughtful approach to every client relationship.

As a lifelong endurance athlete and two-time U.S. Olympic Trials marathon qualifier, I believe the same patience, rigor, and long-term mindset required for successful marathoning are essential to achieving lasting financial outcomes. At the core of my work is a deep respect for each client’s goals and priorities – not only in achieving financial success, but in exploring the question, “What else is possible?” – and a commitment to helping them move forward with clarity and confidence.
Full description:
Brandon Mull is Founder and Principal Wealth Advisor for Marathon Wealth Advisors. He brings nearly two decades of experience spanning wealth advisory, investment management, and derivatives trading to serve the needs of his clients. Brandon’s unique expertise lies in the powerful combination of portfolio management paired with customized financial planning which helps clients confidently address key risks such as inflation, market volatility, as well as tax and estate exposure, ensuring their wealth lasts throughout their retirement years.

Prior to founding Marathon Wealth Advisors, Brandon’s career experience included roles in equity research, as well as proprietary futures and options trading. He later was a portfolio manager at Morgan Stanley where he and his team managed and set investment strategy for high-net-worth relationships. Most recently, Brandon was a Senior Vice President at a top wealth management firm, serving as head of their Detroit office with a fourfold growth of relationships, and leading their expansion into the Chicago market.

Brandon holds a BA in Business/Economics from Wheaton College, and holds a rare combination of rigorous credentials, obtaining both the CFA (Chartered Financial Analyst) and CFP (Certified Financial Planner) designations. As a four-time collegiate All-American, Brandon eventually became an avid marathon runner, twice qualifying for the U.S. Olympic Trials (2016 and 2020). He believes that the discipline, rigor, and long-term approach required for successful marathoning are analogous to those required for successful financial outcomes and embody the spirit and purpose of Marathon Wealth Advisors.

At the core of Brandon’s work is a deep respect for each client’s individual story, goals, and priorities. He views his role as a trusted partner, helping clients make informed decisions, prepare for the unexpected, and move forward with confidence toward the life they want to build.

Name: Brandon Wyand
Intro description:
Hi, I’m Brandon. I’m the Founder of Out West Financial and a financial advisor based in Morrison, Colorado. I help people make thoughtful financial decisions without getting distracted by market noise or the latest trend.

My approach brings together financial planning, tax considerations, estate and trust planning, and investment strategy. The numbers matter, but so do your priorities and how you feel about the choices in front of you. My role is to give you the context and perspective to make informed decisions that fit your life.
Full description:
Brandon Wyand is the Founder of Out West Financial and brings more than a decade of experience in wealth management. He earned his CFP® designation in 2018 and has held advisory roles at Compound Planning, Vanguard, Personal Capital, and Empower Advisory Group. He also obtained Series 63 and 65 licenses and graduated from Arizona State University with a degree in Business Entrepreneurship.

Entrepreneurship was part of Brandon’s life well before wealth management. He ran a successful eBay business through high school and college and purchased his first home in Old Town Scottsdale during his senior year. That entrepreneurial background continues to shape the practical, independent perspective he brings to his work today.

Now based in Morrison, Colorado, Brandon enjoys skiing, riding his Aprilia Tuono V4 1100RR, seeing live music at Red Rocks, and exploring Colorado with his wife and their three dogs.

Name: Brett Tushingham
Intro description:
Hi 👋🏼 I’m Brett. I’m a financial advisor based in Wilmington, North Carolina, with more than 20 years of experience helping families prepare for retirement and make informed decisions about their financial futures.

My work focuses on retirement planning, tax planning, lifetime income strategies, Social Security, and estate considerations. I take a proactive approach, looking ahead for planning opportunities and coordinating with clients’ CPAs and other trusted professionals so the different parts of their financial lives work together.
Full description:
Brett Tushingham has spent more than 20 years in wealth management, helping families plan for retirement and navigate the financial decisions that come with this stage of life. He began his career on Wall Street, where he gained experience in the financial industry before deciding he wanted to work more directly with families and their financial goals.

That shift led Brett to financial advising. Since 2014, he has owned and operated a wealth management practice focused on retirement and tax planning for families nearing retirement. His work commonly addresses questions around retirement income, Social Security, taxes, and estate considerations.

Brett is a CERTIFIED FINANCIAL PLANNER™ professional and holds a BBA in Finance from Pace University. Based in Wilmington, North Carolina, he works with clients nationwide.

Name: Brian Boswell
Intro description: Hi there! 👋🏼 I'm Brian, I specialize in investment management and custom tailored financial planning for physicians. Drawing on my firsthand understanding of the challenges faced by physicians, I offer guidance on protecting your assets, minimizing taxes, and preparing for the future.

Name: Brian Jellig
Intro description: Hi there! I’m Brian Jellig, a Principal Wealth Advisor from San Diego, California, specializing in retirement portfolio strategies and income planning. My passion lies in simplifying the complexities of investments, finances, and retirement for my clients. My father worked as an Estate Planning Attorney. From him and my grandfather, I learned the basics of investing and building wealth early on. After working with clients for almost ten years, I love the journey of helping them endeavor to reach financial success for their families.
Full description:
Brian Jellig, CFP®, is a Principal Wealth Advisor in San Diego, California, who endeavors to help his clients retire with confidence and clarity through comprehensive, customized retirement income planning strategies.

Growing up here in San Diego, CA, Brian spent a lot of time around his father, a local Estate Planning Attorney with a private practice, and his grandfather, a career Electrical Engineer for Kearfott. His conversations around the dinner table as a kid were on topics like the power of “compound interest over time” and the concept that “your dollars are your employees and you need to put them to work.” These laid the groundwork for a meaningful career as a financial advisor.

Brian graduated from PLNU in San Diego, CA, and spent many years working in the business world. In those working years, he always invested extra funds into a family trust portfolio he set up. He also invested in rental properties both locally and out of state.

Following the passing of both his grandparents, Brian didn’t want all the financial knowledge he had gained to go to waste. He became inspired to share his knowledge and experience to help others gain their financial independence.

As a Principal Wealth Advisor, he has worked for Edward Jones, Epstein & White, and Mercer Advisors. Today, he is excited about continuing his career and serving clients at Savvy.

Name: Brian Mills
Intro description: Hi there👋🏾, I'm Brian Mills, a Wealth Manager and Financial Advisor based in Los Angeles, with over 8 years of dedicating my wealth management practice to protecting my client's assets, and growing them in smarter, customized ways. My experience lies in providing personalized solutions for diversifying and safeguarding hard earned client wealth to address dynamic markets. I also offer comprehensive financial planning services, encompassing proactive tax and estate planning, to assist clients in embracing life's ebbs and flows with confidence, while optimizing their financial landscape.
Full description:
Brian Mills is a financial services professional with over a decade of experience, with the most recent six years being at a prominent multi-family office advisory firm. He brings the knowledge, experience, and enthusiasm required to guide investors through the complexities of proactive tax planning, estate planning, financial strategies, and diversified investment management, helping them achieve their financial goals effectively.

As a former Division 1 athlete and graduate of Princeton University's Psychology and Neuroscience department, Brian possesses a uniquely diverse range of expertise. He has repurposed his athlete-work ethic and focused approach on deeply understanding his clients, providing proactive, personalized advice in investment management and financial planning. With a keen eye on tax and estate planning, Brian, as a Wealth Manager at Savvy, merges his passion and strength in building connections with people.

Apart from serving clients, he is dedicated to giving back to his community, serving as a local Advisory Board member for CollegeTrack. This non-profit organization is committed to supporting, mentoring, and providing resources to underserved youth in local and nationwide communities. In his free time, he enjoys spending time with his girlfriend and their two dogs, and appreciates live music, traveling, sports, and art.

Name: Brian Mocogni
Intro description: Hi there👋🏼 I'm Brian, a Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA®) and Wealth Manager with over 20 years of experience. I am passionate about helping clients navigate complex financial landscapes through personalized strategies. My ability to analyze economic trends and provide data-driven insights that empower individuals and businesses to help achieve their long-term financial goals.
Full description:
Brian Mocogni is a highly accomplished Chartered Financial Analyst who specializes in retirement planning, portfolio management, economic analysis, business planning, and quantitative analysis. Known for his meticulous approach to financial strategy, Brian has dedicated his career to helping clients navigate complex investment landscapes to strive to achieve their long-term financial goals.

As a CFA® charterholder, Brian upholds the highest standards of ethical investment practices and advanced financial analysis. His ability to synthesize economic trends and deliver data-driven insights has made him a trusted advisor for individuals and businesses alike.

Outside of his professional pursuits, Brian is an avid hiker, fitness enthusiast, and family man. He values physical wellness and enjoys exploring the outdoors, while cherishing time spent with his loved ones.

Name: Bruce Larsen
Intro description: Hi, I’m Bruce Larsen. For more than three decades, I’ve dedicated my career to helping individuals and families navigate retirement, understand their options, and organize their financial lives with clarity and purpose. My work blends retirement planning, financial planning, and estate and trust planning — all supported by my background in tax and multi-generational guidance. I focus on creating an experience where clients feel informed, supported, and confident in the decisions ahead.
Full description:
Bruce Larsen has been helping individuals and families pursue financial security for more than 30 years. His career began in accounting after earning a Bachelor of Science in Accounting from the University of Wyoming in 1988. After nine years in accounting, Bruce transitioned to personal financial planning, where he developed a particular expertise in retirement income, tax planning, estate planning, and Social Security.

In 2020, Bruce brought his practice to Colorado Wealth Group, where he continues to work with clients while collaborating with other advisors and professionals to provide comprehensive financial planning. His approach is highly integrated, recognizing that investment decisions, retirement income, taxes, Social Security, insurance, and estate planning are interconnected.
Bruce has a particular passion for helping clients make informed decisions about taxes in retirement. He is an Enrolled Agent (EA), giving him a strong foundation in federal taxation, and has written a book focused on taxes in retirement. He also developed Tax Acuity, a tax-planning application designed to help financial advisors identify and implement tax-planning opportunities for their clients.

For more than 25 years, Bruce has also specialized in special-needs planning, helping families address the unique financial, estate-planning, and long-term care challenges associated with disability and special-needs situations. He is a Certified Estate Planner™ (CEP®), a designation focused on estate-planning essentials including living trusts, estate taxes, disability and special-needs planning, and related topics.

Bruce's philosophy is centered on helping clients understand not just where they are financially, but how today's decisions can affect their financial security years or even generations into the future. His practice takes a multi-generational approach, working with clients and, when appropriate, helping coordinate planning across their family tree.

Bruce grew up on a cattle ranch in Wyoming and has called Colorado home since 2008. He has a grown son and daughter and enjoys spending time with family, life on his Colorado ranch, team roping, and spending time outdoors.

Name: Bryan Dern
Intro description: Hi, I’m Bryan. I’m a wealth advisor based in the Chicagoland area, working with my dad and brother to support clients as they enter and move through retirement.I help clients build retirement plans that address income, taxes, Social Security, Medicare, Required Minimum Distributions, and other retirement-related decisions. The strategies used to build retirement savings are often different from the strategies used to live on those assets, so I focus on helping clients understand how their money may support their lifestyle over time.
Full description:
Bryan Dern is a wealth advisor based in the Chicagoland area. He works with his father and brother to support clients who are retired or planning to retire soon.

Bryan’s path into wealth management was shaped by watching his father help people navigate retirement and understand how their money could last. Today, Bryan helps clients organize the many moving parts of retirement, including income planning, tax management, Social Security, Medicare, RMDs, and other decisions that can affect retirement cash flow.

Bryan holds the Series 65 license and a Life & Health Insurance License.

Name: Bryson Beirne
Intro description:
Hi 👋🏼 I’m Bryson. I work with business owners, high-earning professionals, and families whose financial lives have become increasingly complex. After more than a decade advising families on significant financial decisions, I’ve learned that wealth is most useful when it is connected to a clear purpose.

My work begins with the life you want to live and the impact you want to have on your family and community. From there, I help bring your investments, taxes, business interests, estate considerations, and charitable goals into one coordinated financial plan. I also work alongside your CPA, attorney, and other professionals so important decisions can be considered together rather than in isolation.
Full description:
Bryson Beirne is a Wealth Advisor at Savvy Wealth who works with business owners, high-earning professionals, retirees, and families navigating increasingly complex financial lives. Before joining Savvy, he spent more than a decade at a large wealth management organization advising ultra-high-net-worth families, business owners, and executives.

Born on Oʻahu, Bryson is a proud Native Hawaiian. Family and community have been important influences throughout his life and continue to shape the way he approaches his work with clients.

Bryson played Division I football at the University of Arizona, where competing at that level taught him discipline and how to perform under pressure. He graduated early and entered the MBA program at the Eller College of Management. Partway through his graduate studies, Bryson stepped away to serve a two-year mission in Alaska. He later returned to complete his MBA and begin his career in wealth management.

Over the course of his career, Bryson has seen how financial decisions can affect families across generations. Those experiences shaped his belief that planning should begin with understanding what a client wants their wealth to accomplish.

Today, Bryson helps clients bring the different parts of their financial lives into a coordinated plan. His work can include preparing business owners for an eventual exit, planning around retirement and career transitions, evaluating tax considerations over multiple years, developing charitable giving strategies, and addressing estate and legacy goals.

Bryson also works closely with clients’ CPAs, attorneys, and other professionals to coordinate decisions across their financial lives. His approach starts with the client’s family, priorities, and intended impact before moving to individual financial strategies.

Bryson and his wife, Annie, live in Denton, Texas. He is active in his church and local community, and they share a love of traveling the world.

Name: Cameron Hunt
Intro description:
Hi 👋🏼 I’m Cameron. I’m a financial advisor based in Bend, Oregon with 17 years of experience in wealth management. I work primarily with high-earning professionals, executives, and families navigating concentrated equity, IPO liquidity events, tax considerations, real estate, and other complex financial decisions.

My background in institutional portfolio construction and research shapes how I approach planning today. I bring investments, taxes, cash flow, risk management, and long-term goals into one coordinated picture, with the aim of helping clients use their wealth to create more flexibility in how they work, spend their time, and plan for the future.
Full description:
Cameron Hunt brings 17 years of wealth management experience to his work with individuals and families. Earlier in his career, he worked in institutional portfolio construction and research, building, managing, and stress-testing portfolios across different market environments. Over time, he became increasingly interested in applying that analytical background directly to the financial decisions people make in their everyday lives.

Today, Cameron works with high-earning professionals and executives, including people managing RSUs, stock options, concentrated equity positions, and liquidity events. His planning work also spans retirement, tax planning, portfolio construction, cash flow, estate considerations, real estate, and alternative investments.

Cameron holds the CFA®, CFP®, and CPWA® designations. He combines the analytical perspective of his investment background with a broader planning process that considers how money connects to time, personal choice, health, meaning, and legacy. His goal is to help clients evaluate their resources in the context of the life they want to build.

Cameron also brings a practical understanding of marketing, particularly from the perspective of a self-directed advisor. That mindset complements his preference for clear communication, thoughtful decision-making, and giving clients a framework they can understand and use.

Cameron and his wife are raising four young children in Central Oregon. His own experience balancing career ambitions, family life, and long-term planning influences how he thinks about wealth. For Cameron, financial planning is not only about accumulating assets. It is also about creating greater flexibility for family, experiences, and the choices that matter over time.

Name: Chan Lim
Intro description:
Hi, I’m Chan. Today I bring nearly 30 years of capital markets experience to the individuals and families I serve.

My approach is built around a simple principle: person before portfolio. Before deciding how assets should be invested, I want to understand what those assets are meant to accomplish. From there, I help bring the pieces together across financial planning, taxes, investments, estate considerations, and insurance while managing client portfolios directly.

I own my practice. Savvy Advisors is the registered investment advisor behind me, providing technology, compliance, and operations — but I make the investment decisions for my clients’ portfolios myself.
Full description:
Chan Lim brings nearly 30 years of capital markets experience to the clients and families he serves. He began his career on the floor of the Chicago Board Options Exchange, where he spent 15 years as a proprietary options and derivatives trader.

His career later took him into institutional relationship management, where he worked with volatility funds and developed relationships with investment managers. Those one-on-one conversations helped Chan realize how much he valued working directly with people and understanding the thinking behind their financial decisions.

That realization led him to private wealth management, where years of working alongside CPAs made tax planning central to how he approaches every client. Today, Chan works with a broad range of clients, from people beginning to invest beyond their workplace retirement plans to retirees, business owners, and individuals managing concentrated stock positions or equity compensation.

Rather than viewing investments in isolation, Chan serves as a central point of coordination among a client's CPA, estate attorney, insurance professionals, and other advisors. His guiding principle is "person before portfolio," beginning with what a client wants their wealth to accomplish before determining how it should be deployed.

Chan holds the Accredited Investment Fiduciary (AIF) designation. He is also an Illinois Life & Health Insurance Producer and earned his BS in Finance from the University of Illinois.

Name: Chase Austin
Intro description:
Hi there 👋🏼 I’m Chase, I’m dedicated to optimizing clients' investments by carefully considering tax implications to maximize efficiencies and minimize tax burdens. With a keen focus on tax factors, my goal is to equip clients for enduring financial security.

I work with business owners, entrepreneurs, and families, and drawing on my Major League Baseball (“MLB”) background, I offer athletes advice on career choices, financial habits, and wealth management strategies.
Full description:
After three years playing in Major League Baseball, Chase parlayed his experience of working with a financial advisor as a professional athlete to become a Financial Advisor himself and help clients manage their financial life just as he was helped. Chase’s financial advisor was instrumental in helping him manage his signing bonus, so he knew then that when his baseball career was over that he wanted to do the same for others. Following his professional baseball career, Chase was given that opportunity when his financial advisor hired him to work with his group and help with other athletes. Chase then transitioned to working with entrepreneurs, athletes, and business owners to help them understand their financial lives. He says he is most rewarded when he is communicating with his clients and helping them achieve their goals and grow with their families.

He attended Elon University where he played baseball and was drafted in the 5th round of the 2009 MLB Draft. In his free time, Chase enjoys spending time with his wife and two daughters, playing golf, and traveling.

Name: Chris Benda
Intro description:
Hi 👋🏼 I’m Chris. I advise successful individuals and families to move from accomplishment to significance, with clarity, confidence, and a financial plan aligned to what truly matters.

At Benda & Co., we believe success is not the finish line. Many people reach a point where they’ve built wealth and achievement, yet feel a deeper question emerging: What is this all for? We serve as partners in that moment, walking alongside our clients as they define what comes next with intention and purpose. Together, we transform wealth from a static resource into a powerful tool for living well today, while preparing thoughtfully for tomorrow.
Full description:
My path to wealth management was shaped by real-world experience long before formal credentials. However, those formal credentials along with over 20 years of experience spearheaded my expertise and proficiency to work with high net worth individuals, families, and institutions.

I am a graduate of Texas Tech University and hold the Certified Investment Management Analyst® certification administered by the Investments and Wealth Institute and taught in conjunction with The Wharton School, University of Pennsylvania. CIMA certification is the peak international, technical portfolio construction program for investment consultants, financial advisors, and wealth management professionals, and it stands out among other financial certifications for its effective emphasis on the combination of theory and practical application.

In addition, I hold the Certified Private Wealth Advisor® designation taught in conjunction with the University of Chicago Booth School of Business. The CPWA program takes a holistic and multidisciplinary approach that includes a deep dive into sophisticated wealth strategies, estate planning, wealth transfer, behavioral finance, family dynamics, tax management, and legacy planning. CPWA® certified professionals are able to identify and analyze the unique challenges high-net-worth individuals face and understand how to develop specific strategies to minimize taxes, monetize and protect assets, maximize growth, and transfer wealth.

Name: Chris Ornée
Intro description: Hi there, I’m Chris. I understand that building wealth is about more than numbers—it’s about clarity, confidence, and long-term vision. My diverse career as a Navy helicopter pilot, hedge fund trader, investment banker, and wealth advisor gives me both the discipline and perspective to help my clients navigate opportunities and challenges. I also love talking about markets and I'm passionate about making complex financial topics easy for clients to understand and apply.
Full description:
Chris brings over two decades of financial experience and leadership across multiple disciplines—including military service, trading, investment banking, and wealth management. He helps clients create clarity and confidence around their wealth by combining data-driven analysis with a deeply personal understanding of their goals and values.

Through a disciplined and transparent approach, Chris partners with entrepreneurs, executives, families, and non-profits to design strategies that integrate investments, tax planning, estate considerations, charitable giving, and retirement goals.

Name: Chris Stennett
Intro description:
Hello 👋🏼 I’m Chris. I focus on building long-term, client-centered relationships by helping individuals and families navigate their financial journey with clarity and confidence. My approach centers on understanding each client’s unique goals, whether that’s planning for retirement, managing investments, or creating strategies for wealth transfer.

I believe trust is built through transparency and collaboration. By actively listening and tailoring strategies to each client’s circumstances, I aim to simplify complex financial decisions and provide solutions that empower clients to move forward with confidence.
Full description:
Chris Stennett is a CERTIFIED FINANCIAL PLANNER™ practitioner with a genuine passion for helping individuals and families achieve financial freedom. His approach centers on education and empowerment, guiding clients through the complexities of personal finance so they can make confident, informed decisions that align with their goals. Chris believes financial planning isn’t just about building wealth—it’s about creating clarity and peace of mind for every stage of life.

As a life-long learner, Chris is constantly expanding his knowledge, often tuning into financial planning podcasts to stay on top of industry trends. While he jokes that it might sound boring, Chris’s clients quickly recognize the dedication behind it: a commitment to always bringing fresh ideas and strategies to the table.

At the heart of his work is a deep focus on relationships. Chris takes the time to truly understand each client’s unique story, values, and goals, building personalized plans that evolve as life does. Whether it’s designing retirement income strategies, guiding families through tax-smart investing, or simplifying complex planning decisions, he strives to make financial advice approachable, clear, and tailored.

Outside the office, Chris is proud to be a husband to his wife, Emily, and a father to two young daughters, Scarlett and Ivy, who keep life full of joy and perspective. An avid (though self-proclaimed “average”) golfer, he dreams of playing at the world’s best courses and enjoys connecting with clients over a shared love of the game.

Name: Christian Giannangeli
Intro description:
Hi, I'm Christian Giannangeli, CFP®, Founder of Lockwood Private Wealth, an independent wealth management firm.

I serve as a "personal CFO" to professionals with equity compensation, business owners, and families preparing for retirement: one advisor who sees your whole financial picture, coordinates every specialist in your life, and plans forward for life's biggest decisions.

My goal is simple: to be the first call you make when life and money intersect.
Full description:
After nearly a decade advising some of the most sophisticated families in the country at J.P. Morgan, Merrill Lynch, and a billion-dollar independent firm, the lesson that stuck with me is that an advisor's greatest value isn't solely managing investments. It's helping people make better decisions with their money.

As my clients' "personal CFO", I oversee and coordinate every part of their financial lives. Investment management is a critical component, but my role extends far beyond the portfolio: evaluating major financial decisions, navigating equity compensation and business ownership, planning taxes proactively, and coordinating with CPAs, estate attorneys, and insurance professionals so every piece of their financial life works together.

Like my clients, I'm a business owner making decisions about my own cash flow, family, and time, so the conversation is personal and practical, not theoretical.

Name: Christopher Ishack
Intro description:
Hi there! I’m Chris, a wealth advisor based in Orlando, Florida, with nearly two decades of experience helping individuals and families make thoughtful decisions around their investments, retirement, and broader financial lives. Throughout my career, I have developed a deep passion for helping clients turn complex situations into clear and disciplined strategies.

I work primarily with affluent and high-net-worth individuals and families, including professionals, executives, business owners, and people approaching or already in retirement. My approach starts with understanding what you are trying to accomplish, along with your tax situation, risk tolerance, income needs, liquidity needs, and personal preferences. From there, I build a tailored investment and financial planning strategy around the life you are working toward. Clients work directly with me, and I place a strong emphasis on being accessible when advice is needed and delivering a highly personalized experience.
Full description:
Christopher Ishack brings 17 years of experience in financial services and wealth management to his work with clients. After earning his Bachelor of Business Administration from the University of Miami, he began his career at Northwestern Mutual. His early work introduced him to insurance, financial protection, investments, and comprehensive planning, and helped shape his interest in the investment side of wealth management.

While working full time, Christopher returned to the University of Miami to earn his MBA. After five years with Northwestern Mutual, he joined Bank of America and Merrill Lynch, where he spent the next 12 years working with individuals and families through changing markets and different stages of their financial lives.

Over the course of his career, Christopher developed a particular interest in helping clients bring structure to financial decisions that can involve several moving parts. His work often includes investment and portfolio management, retirement income planning, tax-aware investing, concentrated stock positions, fixed-income strategies, direct indexing, tax-loss harvesting, and alternative investments. When a client’s needs involve tax or estate planning, he can also coordinate investment decisions with the client’s CPA and attorney.

Christopher places a strong emphasis on accessibility and communication. He wants clients to understand the reasoning behind their financial decisions and to feel comfortable reaching out when an important question comes up, rather than limiting conversations to scheduled reviews.

Born and raised on Long Island, New York, Christopher now calls Orlando, Florida home. Outside of work, he has maintained a passion for fitness and strength training for two decades. He also enjoys traveling, discovering new places, and spending time with the people closest to him.

Name: Cindy Alvarez
Intro description:
Hello 👋🏼 I'm Cindy. I work with a diverse group of clients to help navigate complex financial decisions by offering personalized financial and tax planning strategies. I help with decision-making when it comes to the more simple tasks of how to fund home down payments, when to take Social Security, how to exercise stock options, when to sell a business, and how to financially navigate divorce. There are more complex tasks that require tax and estate planning strategies where private market investments come into play.

I cultivate strong relationships with my clients by actively listening to their needs then applying recommendations through planning. Trust is vital, and I’m committed to collaborating closely to help bring confidence and help clients achieve their financial goals.
Full description:
Cindy Alvarez approaches each workday with a clear purpose: to help clients access the wealth management resources they need to align their financial priorities and help achieve their goals. She is passionate about delivering innovative, results-driven strategies tailored to each client's unique situation.

Though many clients initially seek help with asset management, Cindy quickly demonstrates that her approach goes far beyond simply managing investments—she strives to invest in her clients' well-being. By building strong, trusting relationships, Cindy takes the time to understand each client's life goals and crafts wealth management plans that reflect those aspirations. Whether she's helping grandparents secure a legacy for their grandchildren, presenting tax-efficient investment options to high-income earners, or guiding individuals through the impact of market fluctuations on their portfolios, her focus is always on adding value to their financial journey.

Communication is at the heart of Cindy's work. Drawing on her extensive background in marketing and communications, she blends her investment experience with a commitment to keeping clients informed and engaged. From the initial onboarding process to regular reviews and ongoing check-ins, Cindy ensures that strategies remain aligned with clients' long-term goals, adjusting as life circumstances evolve.

A key part of Cindy's success is her role in building and mentoring a high-performing team. She provides strategic leadership to fellow advisors and is deeply involved in fostering the professional development of the firm's staff. Cindy strongly believes in the power of a multi-generational team to offer diverse perspectives and enrich the client experience.

Outside of her professional life, Cindy is dedicated to her family. She cherishes spending time with her two children, who each live on different coasts, and enjoys traveling with them to explore the great outdoors through hiking, camping, and experiencing the beauty of the mountains.

Name: Clayton Johnson
Intro description:
Hi, I’m Clayton. I work with business owners and executives who have built meaningful wealth and are facing increasingly complex decisions around taxes, investments, estate planning, executive compensation, and business transitions.

My approach starts with the after-tax result. I look across a client’s full balance sheet and coordinate decisions around where assets are held, when gains are realized, how compensation is structured, and how planning connects with a client’s CPA and attorney. The goal is to bring clarity to complicated situations and create a coordinated financial plan that reflects what the client is trying to accomplish.
Full description:
Clayton Johnson is a Wealth Advisor at Savvy with more than 10 years of experience helping business owners, executives, and affluent families navigate complex financial decisions. His work brings together tax planning, investment strategy, estate and wealth transfer planning, executive compensation, and broader financial planning.

Clayton has particular depth working with business owners through periods of growth, liquidity, and succession. He helps clients evaluate decisions across their entire balance sheet rather than treating taxes, investments, and estate considerations as separate conversations. His planning process places significant emphasis on the after-tax result and on coordinating decisions with a client’s other professionals.

Prior to joining Savvy, Clayton worked at Aerodigm Wealth and Squire Wealth Advisors, where he integrated tax and wealth planning for business owners and executives. He holds a Bachelor of Science in Business Management from Brigham Young University and is both a CERTIFIED FINANCIAL PLANNER® professional and a Certified Private Wealth Advisor®. He is a member of the Investments & Wealth Institute and serves on the board of the Utah Valley Estate Planning Council.

Outside of work, Clayton enjoys playing sports, with volleyball at the top of the list. He also enjoys traveling with his wife and three daughters and spending time serving in his community and church.

Name: Clint Heisler
Intro description:
I'm Clint Heisler, CFP®, ChFC®, CLU®, a Founding Partner and Wealth Advisor at Wealth Haus, where I help high-net-worth families, business owners, executives, and professionals nearing retirement build financial plans that integrate every part of their wealth. With three industry designations and over a decade and a half of experience across the planning, wealth management, and insurance sides of the business, I bring a holistic perspective to clients who want more than a portfolio…they want a blueprint that maps out all the variables that make up their financial picture.

‍

‍

Name: Clint Seefeldt
Intro description:
Hello 👋🏼 I’m Clint. I work with physicians, HENRYs, retirees, and small business owners to design personalized financial plans that help them achieve clarity and confidence around their money. My expertise spans retirement planning, tax strategies, student loan repayment, estate planning, and investment management. I understand that financial planning is not one-size-fits-all - especially for medical professionals and business owners facing unique challenges and opportunities.

I combine deep financial planning knowledge with a hands-on, relationship-driven approach. Whether it’s building a retirement income strategy, protecting assets, or tackling debt, I treat every client like family and focus on delivering practical, actionable strategies tailored to their goals. My goal is simple: to help clients make confident decisions and give them the confidence that comes from having a plan to track toward their financial milestones.
Full description:
Clint focuses on creating comprehensive financial plans and tailored investment strategies, with a particular emphasis on serving medical professionals and small business owners. His work includes retirement planning, investment management, estate and legacy planning, employee benefit guidance, tax-efficient strategies, and insurance planning.

Clint understands that medical professionals often face unique financial challenges, and he takes pride in designing strategies that reflect each client’s individual circumstances. With his wife Clair working as a nurse practitioner, he has a deep appreciation for the dedication and sacrifices that come with a career in medicine.

Clint earned his CERTIFIED FINANCIAL PLANNER™ designation in 2023 and is an active member of the Financial Planning Association, the Riley Advisors Board, and the Secret Families Board.

He lives in Fishers, Indiana with his wife Clair, their three sons, Cal, Cam, and Charlie, and their two dogs, Wrigley and JoJo. Outside of work, Clint enjoys coaching and playing baseball, golfing, rowing, and spending time with his family.

Name: Colin Farr
Intro description: Hi there! 👋🏼 I’m Colin. I enjoy taking the time to understand each client’s individual situation and creating strategies to help them meet their goals. It’s also important to me that my clients understand how their investments work and why their portfolio is set up in a certain manner. From crafting investment strategies to tax optimization, income planning, and preparing for milestones like retirement or college funding – I’m here to help.
Full description:
Colin is originally from Northeast Ohio but made his way to Colorado for college and to follow his passion for the great outdoors. His career in finance began at Charles Schwab over 14 years ago, where he spent the last decade as a Financial Consultant, assisting high net worth individuals and families. Holding the title of Certified Financial Planner (CFP®), Colin thrives on nurturing enduring connections and aiding clients in reaching their financial aspirations. He has moved to Savvy to offer his clients a more tailored experience alongside our tech forward team.

Residing in Denver, he unwinds from work by indulging in activities such as hiking, camping, and mountain biking. Colin enjoys spending time outdoors with his wife, Sarah, their two children, and their dog, Oliver.

Name: Conrad Levesque
Intro description:
Hi, I’m Conrad. I’m a financial advisor based in Marietta, Georgia and the founder of DELVR Wealth. I work with business owners, high-earning families, and legacy-minded individuals who want more than investment management alone. My approach centers on comprehensive financial planning, with a strong focus on tax optimization, business owner planning, and long-term legacy strategies.

Before becoming a financial advisor, I spent years working with tax clients and kept hearing questions that called for broader financial guidance. That experience shaped the way I work today. I help clients connect the dots across their business, personal finances, and long-term goals so they can make informed decisions and spend more time on what matters most to them.
Full description:
Conrad Levesque is the founder of DELVR Wealth. He brings 10 years of wealth management experience, along with more than two decades of experience serving tax clients and advising on complex financial matters for individuals and business owners.

Conrad earned his Bachelor in Business Administration in Management and his Bachelor of Science in Accounting from Kennesaw State University. He later earned his Certified Public Accountant designation and expanded his background through work in tax and accounting, real estate development, business consulting, and financial auditing for the State of Georgia.

In 2017, Conrad expanded his practice to include consulting and financial planning services. Today, he is a Certified Financial Planner professional®  and also holds the Certified Exit Planning Advisor credential, which supports his work with business owners who want to understand, protect, and improve the value of their businesses as part of their overall net worth strategy. His professional affiliations include the AICPA and the Georgia Society of CPAs.

Outside of work, Conrad enjoys spending time with his wife, Chelsea, and their two daughters, Caroline and Carson. He is also an avid golfer and enjoys participating in charity tournaments that support local causes.

Name: Craig Austad
Intro description:
Hi 👋🏼 I’m Craig. I specialize in helping clients align their finances with their values, creating thoughtful strategies that can help reduce stress and elevate both personal and financial well-being. My goal is to help keep my clients focused on what truly matters to them.

Many of my clients are also part of the "sandwich generation," navigating the complex responsibilities of caring for aging parents, supporting children through college, and planning for their own retirement. With a clear financial strategy—especially one that includes a well-structured college planning process—education can feel more affordable, all while ensuring other financial priorities stay on track.
Full description:
Craig Austad has been in the financial services industry for over 25 years, and his passion lies in helping individuals take control of their finances. He has extensive experience working with clients and utilizes this knowledge to manage his practice. He wears many hats at the firm, but his most important job is helping his clients make sound decisions about their assets. He believes it is rewarding to develop effective strategies for his clients to help them achieve their goals.

Craig is a CERTIFIED FINANCIAL PLANNER™ professional and takes his industry education seriously. He is also a Chartered Life Underwriter™ and proud member of the Financial Planning Association of Colorado. When not in the office, he can be found in the mountains skiing with his wife and two kids, getting together with friends and family, and enjoying all that Colorado has to offer.

Name: Dan Brady
Intro description:
Hi there 👋🏼 I'm Dan, an experienced professional with over 25 years in institutional trading and investing. My expertise lies in investment allocations, helping clients overcome financial challenges, and understanding their unique needs.

As a financial advisor, I prioritize building strong, trusting relationships through empathy, open dialogue, and a deep connection. Regardless of financial standing, I am dedicated to assisting clients in achieving their goals. Let's embark on this journey together!
Full description:
Dan brings 25+ years of experience in financial services together with a wide depth of financial acumen and differentiated perspective given his prior experience as both an institutional trader and sales trader. This background enables him to help guide clients through the full spectrum of financial concerns. Having invested through the bull and bear markets, he understands the importance of the big picture and that times of uncertainty can often be times of opportunity. In today's environment of economic and political uncertainty, clients need a financial compass - an experienced and trusted advisor who can help them navigate toward their financial futures with greater confidence.

Dan works with a broad spectrum of clients, including professionals, private equity executives, small business owners, and other successful individuals and families. While each client has their own unique financial goals, they all have one thing in common: appreciating the value of advice from a trusted, experienced advisor who has been through decades of boom and bust cycles.

He currently lives in Rye, New York, with his wife, Christine, and their four children, Ella, Logan, Connor, and Charlie.

Name: Dan Perrino
Intro description: Hello there! 👋🏼 I'm Dan, originally from Chicago and now residing in Bellingham, Washington. My lifelong passion for finance and the stock market has driven my career path. After completing my studies in business administration, with a focus on finance and information systems at Fordham University, I embarked on my professional journey at a financial technology company. As my expertise grew, I transitioned into financial advising and eventually found my way to Merrill in Bellingham. Presently, as a member of Savvy Advisors, I utilize their tech resources to provide exceptional client service.
Full description:
Dan grew up in the Chicago area and developed a strong interest in the stock market. After completing his bachelor's degree in business administration with concentrations in finance and information systems from Fordham University's Gabelli School of Business in New York City, he embarked on his career at Eze Software Group, a financial technology company and electronic trading software. Starting in client service, Dan steadily progressed to consulting and implementation roles, where he directly interacted with traders, portfolio managers, and operations personnel at institutional trade desks.

During his time at Eze, Dan had the pleasure of meeting his wife, Jess. Together, they decided to relocate to Bellingham, Washington, to be closer to her family. This prompted Dan’s transition to Merrill, where he served as a financial advisor, gaining valuable experience before eventually taking on the responsibility of managing a local independent advisory office in Bellingham.

In 2022, Dan joined Savvy, drawn by their cutting-edge technology resources, which he viewed as a valuable opportunity to provide better client service. Dan’s specialization lies in assisting individuals in his community in achieving their retirement goals. For those approaching retirement, his focus is on implementing effective savings and contribution strategies. For those already in retirement, he prioritizes sustainable and tax-efficient income strategies. Collaborating closely with clients' tax professionals is crucial to ensure that his investment advice aligns seamlessly with their unique tax situations.

Name: Daniel F. Murphy
Intro description:
Hi, I'm Daniel. I'm a Managing Partner and Wealth Manager with Palladian Asset Management, based in Midlothian, VA.
