For more than 38 years, I've helped a select group of individuals and families preserve, manage, and transfer wealth through comprehensive financial planning, investment management, and estate planning.

My work starts with a thorough financial plan. From there, I design and manage portfolios on a discretionary basis, aligning each strategy with a client's goals, risk tolerance, and long-term priorities.
Full description:
Daniel F. Murphy works with a select group of clients, helping them create, preserve, and transfer wealth. His planning process starts with understanding each client's financial picture, family needs, and long-term goals. From there, he designs investment strategies that reflect each client's objectives and risk tolerance.

Name: Daniel Myers

Name: David L. Berkowitz
Intro description:
Hi, I’m David. I’ve spent 40 years in financial services — trading and research at a Soros-backed hedge fund, five years advising CEOs and boards at Stern Stewart & Co., and more than twenty years running my own firm, ValueAligned Partners, which I founded in 2002. I hold two degrees from Columbia: a BA in Economics from Columbia College and an MBA from Columbia Business School.

Today I work mainly with people 50 and older, retirees, and their families. I help them answer the questions that matter most at this stage: Do we have enough? How do we turn savings into income? And would the family be OK if something happened tomorrow? I coordinate the financial, tax, and estate pieces as wealth passes from one generation to the next.

My approach centers on education and direct ownership of individual companies — one advisory fee, no fund fees layered underneath. I want clients, and their families, to understand what they own, how each holding fits their plan, and why staying focused on the long term matters.
Full description:
David L. Berkowitz is the founder and Chief Investment Officer of ValueAligned Partners. His career spans four decades across hedge fund trading, investment research, corporate finance consulting, and portfolio management.

After earning his B.A. in Economics from Columbia College, David began his career as an entrepreneur before joining Woodward & Associates, an equity hedge fund that managed approximately $250 million at the time. Because the organization was small, David served in several capacities, including trading, research, client service, accounting, and operations. He later became Chief Operating Officer and Head Trader.

David returned to Columbia University to earn his M.B.A. in Finance and Value Investing from Columbia Business School. After graduation, he joined Stern Stewart & Co., the consulting company associated with the development of Economic Value Added, or EVA. During his five years there, he advised businesses on valuation, corporate operations, financial decision-making, and shareholder value. He also taught corporate finance concepts to audiences ranging from executives and board members to employees without formal finance backgrounds.

In 2002, David launched his own investment business. What began as a hedge fund and a relationship with a family office developed into an advisory practice serving individuals and multigenerational families through separately managed accounts.

David created the ValueAligned Investing framework, which combines value investing with an evaluation of management decisions, shareholder alignment, returns on capital, competitive positioning, and share repurchases. Rather than relying on mutual funds, exchange-traded funds, or outside managers, David researches and selects individual companies for client portfolios.

A significant part of David’s work involves helping clients understand market behavior and remain focused during periods of uncertainty. He enjoys teaching clients about the businesses they own and discussing how investment decisions connect with retirement, taxes, estate planning, and family goals.

David also publishes investor education through Berk on Value across video, written articles, and LinkedIn. He has presented to professional organizations and educational audiences in several cities, as well as at Columbia Business School and other business forums.

Asignificant part of David’s work is teaching clients — and their families —what they own: in meetings, in writing, and through the free investor educationhe publishes weekly.

Name: Dean Quintas

The fundamental lessons that Frank learned during his upbringing have been instrumental throughout his professional journey. They have enabled him to establish strong, personal relationships with his clients, understand their priorities, and develop personalized financial plans that secure their financial success.

Frank has had the privilege of teaching the rigorous Retirement Income tax course for H&R Block tax professionals, as well as courses on Employee Stock Plan Compensation, Restricted Stock Units, Employee Stock Purchase Plans, and Non-Qualified Options.

Frank now joins Savvy Advisors, bringing his wealth of experience and passion for financial planning. He resides in Boise, Idaho, with his wife Abby, and their four very active school-age boys. In his spare time, he enjoys volunteering as a coach for their baseball, soccer, and basketball teams. Frank's life is enriched by family, church, and work, and he considers himself very fortunate.

Savvy Advisors does not provide tax, legal or accounting advice.  This material has been prepared for informational purposes.

Name: Gabe Boruff
Intro description:
Hi 👋🏼 I’m Gabe. I’m a financial advisor based in the Tri-Cities, Washington, and I work with individuals, families, high-net-worth clients, and small business owners on financial planning, retirement planning, investment management, and other important financial decisions.

My background as a collegiate and professional baseball player and later as a collegiate coach continues to shape how I work with clients today. Coaching taught me to listen closely, understand someone’s goals, create a plan, and provide steady guidance along the way. I bring that same relationship-focused approach to financial planning, with an emphasis on clear communication and service.
Full description:
Gabe Boruff brings a background in athletics, coaching, and financial services to his work with clients. Before focusing his career on financial advice, Gabe played collegiate and professional baseball through his mid-20s. He then spent more than a decade coaching baseball at the collegiate level.

While coaching, Gabe also worked alongside his father as a financial consultant. That experience introduced him to financial services and gave him an opportunity to see how thoughtful guidance could make a meaningful difference in people’s lives.

After the birth of his third child, Gabe wanted a career that would allow him to spend more time at home with his family. He transitioned back into financial services and became a financial advisor at Edward Jones. In 2019, he joined Integrity Financial, where he spent the following years working alongside other advisors and continuing to develop his planning approach.

Gabe credits his baseball background with shaping many of the values he brings to his practice. Playing taught him the importance of discipline, persistence, and preparation. Coaching taught him how important strong relationships, communication, and trust are when helping someone work toward a goal. Today, he brings those lessons into each client relationship.

Gabe has lived in the Tri-Cities, Washington, since 2013 with his wife, Erika, a second-grade teacher, and their three children. Outside of work, family remains an important part of his life, and he enjoys supporting his children in their academics, sports, and music.

Name: Gary Jones
Intro description:
Hi, I'm Gary Jones. I'm a financial advisor based in Lee's Summit, Missouri, with 18 years of experience helping clients plan for retirement, manage their investments, and prepare for important financial transitions.

I believe good financial planning starts with getting to know the person behind the numbers. I take the time to understand what motivates each client, what they want their future to look like, and what matters most to them. From there, we can build a plan together, put it into action, and revisit it as life and priorities change.
Full description:
Gary Jones is a financial advisor with 18 years of experience helping clients work through retirement planning, investment management, portfolio construction, tax considerations, and business and farm succession planning.

His interest in investing began well before he became an advisor. In the 1980s, Gary worked on the operations side of the financial industry with DST. As he began managing some of his own money, he realized that becoming a financial advisor was a natural next step and an opportunity to spend his career helping people.

Today, Gary works with a wide range of clients and believes each relationship should begin with a deeper understanding of what the client wants to accomplish. He takes time to learn about their priorities and motivations before developing a financial plan and investment strategy around their individual circumstances.

Gary also believes financial topics do not need to feel overwhelming. A central part of his work is helping clients understand complex decisions in straightforward terms so they can stay engaged with their plan. As life changes, Gary meets with clients to review their progress and determine whether their financial plan should change with it.

Name: George M Rabon
Intro description:
Hi, I’m George. I’m a financial advisor based in Summerville, South Carolina, with 12 years of experience helping pre-retirees, retirees, business owners, physicians, dentists, and families navigate important financial decisions.

Before becoming an advisor, I worked in public accounting and earned a Master’s degree in Accounting with a focus in Taxation. That background continues to shape how I work with clients today. I bring financial planning, investment management, retirement planning, and tax considerations together so each strategy reflects the client’s broader financial picture.

I believe good planning starts with getting to know the person behind the numbers. My goal is to understand what matters to each client and develop a personalized plan that supports those priorities over time.
Full description:
George Rabon, CFP®, AIF®, is a financial advisor with 12 years of experience working with successful families, business owners, physicians, dentists, pre-retirees, and retirees. His work centers on bringing together financial planning, investment management, retirement planning and tax considerations based on each client’s circumstances and priorities.

George’s path into wealth management began in public accounting. He earned a B.S. in Accounting from Clemson University, where he was a member of the Clemson football team, and later earned his Master’s degree in Accounting from the College of Charleston with a focus in Taxation. He is also a CERTIFIED FINANCIAL PLANNER™ professional and an Accredited Investment Fiduciary®.

His accounting background provides an important perspective when evaluating how investment and planning decisions may affect a client’s broader tax picture.George likes to work alongside clients’ CPAs, attorneys, and other professional advisors to coordinate different areas of their financial lives.

George lives in Summerville, South Carolina, with his wife and three children. His Christian faith is an important part of his life and shapes his view of stewardship and serving others. Outside of work, he enjoys spending time with his family, volunteering at church, playing golf with friends and bow hunting in the outdoors.

For George, wealth management is about helping clients bring greater clarity and intentionality to the resources they have built, while keeping their families, priorities, and long-term goals at the center of the planning process.

Name: Greg Allen
Intro description:
I’m Greg Allen, CEPA®, Founding Partner and Wealth Advisor at Wealth Haus. I spent the first portion of my career in my family’s real estate and development business, where I learned firsthand what it means to build something from the ground up. When the Great Recession hit in 2008, I realized how little I knew about the financial markets and the impact they could have on families, businesses, and long-term wealth. That realization created a pull toward financial planning and wealth management that ultimately changed the course of my career.

‍

Over the last 14 years, I’ve built an advisory practice rooted in the needs I saw within my own family’s life and business. Today, I work with business owners, entrepreneurs, and families who want thoughtful guidance from someone who understands both the opportunities and pressures that come with building wealth in the real world.

‍

Name: Greg Kirwan
Intro description: Hi there👋🏼 I'm Greg, a Certified Financial Planner (CFP®) and Wealth Manager with over 20 years of experience helping clients from ages 30 to 90 strive to achieve their financial dreams through tailored strategies, my passion for building personal, decades-long relationships allows me to craft solutions that evolve with each client’s unique goals and family dynamics. I help guide clients through investment planning, retirement strategies, and generational wealth transitions with care and precision.
Full description:
Greg brings a personal approach to financial planning, serving a diverse range of clients aged 30 to 90. With a passion for retirement planning, income strategies, estate planning, and investment management, he crafts tailored solutions that evolve with each client’s unique goals and family dynamics.

Inspired by early lessons from family and friends, Greg’s curiosity about the interplay of financial elements led him to a career dedicated to guiding others toward financial success. His expertise spans from investment allocation, savings and budgeting, workplace benefits, insurance planning, to generational wealth transitions, ensuring clients feel confident in their financial future.

At Savvy, Greg leverages a collaborative team to deliver cohesive, results-driven plans. Known for building relationships that span decades, he treats clients like family, finds joy in navigating the changing dynamics of their lives, and creates innovative solutions that align with their aspirations.

Name: Gregg Cummings
Intro description:
I'm Gregg Cummings, a Financial Planner and Qualified Plan Consultant. When I opened my own firm in 2011, I had one mission: to deliver dedicated retirement plan consulting and wealth management services to clients nationwide.

Whether you're an individual seeking financial planning guidance or a business looking to offer fiduciary-focused retirement benefits, serving clients is my passion. My background across publishing, software, and communications gave me invaluable insight into the retirement plan needs of businesses and employees at every stage of growth.

I was drawn to financial planning to help people navigate life's stages without making uninformed decisions or chasing returns without a clear goal. I listen first, then help you plan the course. I hold the AIF®, CRPS®, and CPFA designations.

Outside of work, I enjoy traveling with my wife Sheri, walking our dog Maui, and staying active through cycling, swimming, and hiking. I also volunteer regularly at our church and in the local community.
Full description:
Gregg Cummings came to financial advising through a career change after seeing that many people had retirement accounts and savings, but no real plan tying it all together. That realization drew him to this work. He wanted to help people think beyond just investments and build a clearer path around retirement, family needs, estate considerations, and the "what ifs" life brings. With more than 20 years of experience in wealth management, Gregg takes a thoughtful, client-first approach grounded in listening, asking good questions, and building a plan that can evolve over time.

Gregg works with a range of clients, including women, families, and middle-America households, as well as small to midsize businesses with 401(k) plans. He is especially passionate about working with people who want more than just investment management and are willing to engage in the planning process. His focus areas include employer-sponsored plans, financial planning and analysis, retirement planning, and estate and trust planning.

What sets Gregg's approach apart is that he starts by listening. His clients have told him that he asks good questions and genuinely wants what's best for them. He doesn't believe in forcing a one-size-fits-all solution. Instead, he believes in building a living, breathing plan that evolves with each client and their family over time.

What Gregg loves most about this work is helping people get to a place where they have a plan and feel confident they're going to be okay if they stay committed to it. It's incredibly rewarding to help someone move from uncertainty to clarity and feel more secure about their future.

Name: Gunnar Johnson
Intro description:
Hi 👋🏼 I’m Gunnar. I work with families and business owners who want their financial decisions to reflect what matters most to them. For many of my clients, that includes thinking intentionally about stewardship, generosity, and the purpose behind their wealth.

My background in financial counseling, business ownership, ministry, and charitable planning shapes how I approach investment management and financial planning. At True Harvest Private Wealth, I help clients connect their resources with their values and long-term goals.
Full description:
Gunnar Johnson is a wealth manager, business owner, nonprofit leader, investor, and consultant who works with business owners and families seeking to manage their wealth with greater purpose. His perspective has been shaped by decades spent at the intersection of financial stewardship, ministry, business ownership, and charitable planning.

Gunnar’s path began in 1999 with Crown Financial Ministries, where his work in biblical financial counseling laid the foundation for a career centered on the relationship between faith and finances. He later became a budget coach and worked alongside churches to help individuals and families think intentionally about money and possessions. In 2004, Ron Blue invited Gunnar to help build what became Kingdom Advisors, and Gunnar completed the Certified Kingdom Advisor® training in 2006.

His work has continued across ministry, nonprofit leadership, consulting, and entrepreneurship. Gunnar served for 11 years as an executive pastor and spent 12 years as a board member or president of the Christian Stewardship Network. He also spent 15 years serving alongside Israel Firstfruits, supporting entrepreneurship and economic development in Israel. As the owner of five businesses himself, Gunnar understands both the challenges and the rewards that can come with building and leading a company.

Over the years, Gunnar saw a recurring challenge. Generous people wanted to support causes close to their hearts, but the complexities of business ownership, financial planning, and charitable decisions could make it difficult to know how and when to act. That experience ultimately led him into wealth management and to True Harvest Private Wealth.

Today, Gunnar helps families and business owners think through investment planning, strategic spending, charitable goals, and the broader purpose behind their wealth. For clients who share his Christian worldview, that can include conversations about the theology of money and possessions and what faithful stewardship looks like in practice.

That commitment to generosity extends beyond Gunnar’s work with clients. He is involved with Dream Centers, an organization serving vulnerable women and children in Colorado Springs.

Outside of work, Gunnar enjoys exploring Colorado by motorcycle and on skis. He and his wife, Missy, especially enjoy spending time with their granddaughter, Charlie.

Name: Hannah Basil Bryant
Intro description:
Hi, I’m Hannah. I’m a Chicago-based financial planner with 11 years of experience helping professional women, families, and high earners build wealth with intention.

I work with clients navigating equity compensation, career pivots, maternity leave, entrepreneurship, retirement planning, and other meaningful life transitions. My approach starts with understanding your relationship with money, then building a planning framework that reflects your real life, values, and goals.
Full description:
Hannah Basil Bryant, CFP® is a Chicago-based financial planner with 11 years of experience helping professional women and families build wealth with intention.

Her path into financial planning began at her first job in commercial banking, where she noticed that colleagues with the same salary and starting point were making very different financial decisions. Because her mother was a financial planner, Hannah understood the value of early planning and compound interest. She wanted to help close that knowledge gap for people who did not have the same advantage.

In 2015, Hannah joined her mother, Lois Basil, at Basil Financial Group, where she helped organize and expand the business while building services for younger clients. Together, they grew the practice to over $75M in AUM before its acquisition in 2023. Today, Hannah is building her next chapter as an independent financial planner and founder of Ambitious and Aligned, a wealth and coaching platform for women navigating career and life transitions.

Hannah is a contributing voice in Neha Ruch’s The Power Pause, a founding member of the Power Pause Community, and a founding member of Grand Pursuit, a community for entrepreneurial women in pursuit of career success and family fulfillment, not one or the other. She graduated summa cum laude in economics from Knox College and studied corporate finance and international marketing at the London School of Economics. She holds the CFP® designation, is a member of the FPA, and is a sustaining member of Phi Beta Kappa.

A lifelong Chicagoan, Hannah lives in the North Mayfair neighborhood with her husband, Caleb, their two young children, and their dog. Outside of work, she enjoys hosting dinner parties, making memories with her family, stand-up paddle boarding, and traveling.

Name: Hunter Cloud
Intro description:
I’m Hunter, a CPA-turned-financial advisor based in Kentucky.  After three years in public accounting, I wanted to leverage my experience and knowledge for forward planning and optimization.  I work with P&G employees and retirees, executives, business owners, and people approaching or enjoying retirement who want a simpler, more proactive plan.

By combining my tax expertise with holistic financial planning, I help clients simplify their financial life while instilling confidence in their plan moving forward.
Full description: Hunter Cloud, CPA, CFP® is a financial advisor based in Kentucky who specializes in helping clients make confident retirement and tax-planning decisions. He began his career in public accounting, where he spent three years as a CPA, before transitioning into advising to focus on creating proactive, high-impact value for clients. His tax background allows him to concentrate on what is controllable—optimizing cash flow, reducing lifetime tax liability, and aligning financial decisions with long-term goals. Shaped in part by witnessing the financial and personal strain experienced by a close family friend during the 2008 financial crisis, Hunter takes seriously the responsibility of guiding clients through all phases of life. He believes that less is more when it comes to advice, favoring clear, concise communication and an approach rooted in listening, education, and trust.

Name: Jack Fitzpatrick
Intro description: Hello there! 👋🏼 I'm Jack, originally from the East Coast and now based in Scottsdale, Arizona. With 35 years in the finance industry, I’ve developed a deep understanding of markets, risk management, and strategic financial planning. My career began as a foreign exchange trading executive at Morgan Stanley, followed by roles in portfolio management before transitioning into wealth advising. Today, as a fiduciary and member of Savvy Advisors, I leverage their platform of resources to provide comprehensive financial guidance tailored to my clients' unique needs.
Full description:
Over the past 35 years in the finance industry, Jack has developed a deep understanding of markets, risk management, and strategic financial planning. He spent over two decades as a foreign exchange trading executive at Morgan Stanley before transitioning into portfolio management at Gelber Group and Fitzco Trading. Most recently, he served as a wealth advisor at JM Arbour Wealth Management, where he focused on helping clients navigate their financial futures with confidence.

Jack holds a Series 65 license and is a certified Life Insurance Producer in Arizona, with additional licenses in California, Utah, and Massachusetts. His approach to wealth management is rooted in understanding each client’s unique goals, risk tolerance, and long-term aspirations. Whether it’s investment management, retirement planning, or risk mitigation, he prioritizes education and clear communication to empower his clients to make informed financial decisions.

Based in Scottsdale, Arizona, Jack is a devoted husband and father of four daughters. He enjoys an active lifestyle and is passionate about F3 fitness, hiking, golfing, and skiing. He also shares a special bond with my beloved dog, Jeter.

Name: Jacob DuBose
Intro description: Hello there! 👋🏼 I'm Jacob, a seasoned wealth advisor at Savvy with over two decades of experience. My journey began in the tech sales industry, where I developed a keen interest in the decision-making process and financial planning. I’m here to help you reach your financial goals.

Name: Jacob LaRue
Intro description: Hi there! I’m Jacob LaRue, CFP®, a Wealth Manager from Minneapolis, MN, passionate about providing tailored retirement planning services to MedTech employees and their families. As part of the Perspective 6 Wealth Advisors, I assist in comprehensive financial plan development, investment management, and running client review meetings. With focus areas across retirement income planning, Social Security analysis, and retirement distribution analysis, I’m dedicated to helping clients achieve financial freedom in retirement.
Full description:
Jacob LaRue, CFP®, a Wealth Manager from Minneapolis, MN, has spent nearly a decade providing tailored retirement planning services to MedTech employees and their families. As a Bachelor of Science in Financial Planning at Western Kentucky University, Jacob became passionate about financial literacy and how he could help others manage their finances more efficiently. His desire to help others through comprehensive financial planning led him to join Perspective 6 Wealth Advisors as a Financial Advisor in 2016. Since then, he’s been dedicated to helping families and individuals pursue their personal and financial goals.

In addition to his CFP® certification, Jacob has specialized knowledge in:

Employee Benefits

Retirement Income Planning

Social Security Analysis

Pension Analysis

Retirement Distribution Analysis

He also serves on the Perspective 6 Wealth Advisors Investment Committee.

Outside of work, Jacob loves to spend time with his family, Haley, Jace, Maeve, Kyler, and their cat, Kitty. Together, the family enjoys traveling, playing sports, and trying new local foods and shops. Jacob also enjoys baseball, golf, and playing on a local flag football team.

Name: Jacob Ray
Intro description:
Hi, I’m Jacob. Partner and Chief Operating Officer at Colorado Wealth Group. A Colorado native, I’m known for my attention to detail and my ability to simplify complex financial concepts. I work closely with clients to navigate all aspects of their financial lives—from retirement planning and company stock option divestitures to cash flow management and education planning.

My goal is to provide you with insight, clarity, and a steady hand so you can make confident decisions and achieve your version of financial success.
Full description:
Jacob brings over a decade of experience in the financial services industry to his role at Colorado Wealth Group. He holds a Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration from the University of Northern Colorado and an MBA from Western Kentucky University.

Jacob’s professional designations include Accredited Wealth Management Advisor (AWMA®) and Accredited Investment Fiduciary (AIF®).

These credentials, combined with his deep experience, allow him to deliver comprehensive, tailored financial planning and investment guidance for each client’s unique situation.

Outside of work, Jacob enjoys spending time with his wife, Leanne, and their children. They love exploring Colorado’s outdoors, trying new restaurants and breweries, and enjoying time with family and friends.

Name: James Kuxhaus
Intro description:
Hi, I'm James.

For more than 20 years, I've helped individuals, families, and business owners build financial strategies that support both their personal goals and the causes they care about. My approach combines retirement planning, estate planning, tax-aware investing, and charitable planning into one coordinated financial strategy.

My faith plays an important role in my life and in the way I serve clients. Whether you're preparing for retirement, building a legacy for your family, or looking for meaningful ways to support your church or community, I believe your financial plan should reflect your values while adapting to life's changing needs.
Full description:
James Kuxhaus is a Wealth Manager with more than two decades of experience helping individuals, families, and business owners navigate important financial decisions. His career began after serving as a U.S. Air Force officer and aviator, followed by leadership roles in high-tech manufacturing. Those experiences developed the planning, leadership, and problem-solving skills that continue to shape his approach to financial planning today.

James works with clients seeking comprehensive financial guidance that brings together retirement income planning, investment management, estate planning, charitable giving, and tax-aware strategies. He believes the most effective financial plans are built around each client's goals, values, and long-term priorities rather than focusing on individual financial products.

As a CERTIFIED FINANCIAL PLANNER™ professional, James has completed advanced education, met rigorous experience requirements, and maintains ongoing continuing education to stay current on financial planning strategies. Throughout his career, he has enjoyed helping clients reach meaningful milestones, whether retiring comfortably, helping children attend college, or making lasting contributions to the organizations they value most.

Outside of work, James enjoys spending time with his wife and their two children. His faith remains a central part of his life, and he values opportunities to serve his church and local community.

Name: James Soukup
Intro description:
Hi 👋🏼 I'm James. For more than 20 years, I've helped individuals and families plan for their financial futures, with a particular focus on helping people prepare for retirement and navigate the years that follow.

Many of my clients have spent decades building careers, businesses, farms, and families. When retirement approaches, I help them bring the different pieces of their financial lives together through retirement planning, income planning, asset allocation, and legacy planning. I take the time to understand what matters to each client so we can build a plan around the life they want to live.
Full description:
James Soukup brings more than 20 years of financial advisory experience to his work with individuals and families. He has been a CERTIFIED FINANCIAL PLANNER® professional since 2014 and focuses much of his work on helping clients prepare for retirement and organize the different pieces of their financial lives.

His interest in investing began well before his professional career. James grew up on a farm in eastern Nebraska, where some of his first paychecks came from moving irrigation pipe and detasseling seed corn. At around 12 years old, James and his brother each raised a bucket calf and used some of the proceeds to buy stock. That early experience sparked an interest in investing that would eventually become his career.

James earned his undergraduate degree from the University of Nebraska at Kearney and later earned his MBA from the University of Arkansas. Over the course of his career, he has worked in both large and small financial services organizations, including full-service and discount brokerage environments.

Today, James works with individuals and families from a wide range of backgrounds and at many different stages of life, including farmers, business owners, educators and other professionals, and retirees. He takes a comprehensive approach to financial planning, helping clients navigate retirement and income planning, investment and asset allocation strategies, concentrated stock positions, tax-aware planning, and estate and legacy considerations.

Relationships are central to how James works. He takes time to understand a client's background, family, priorities, and plans for retirement. Sometimes that means meeting across a conference table. Other times, it can mean making a house call and getting to know a client over the dinner table.

James and his wife, Mikka, live in Linwood, Kansas, with their three children. Outside of work, he enjoys gardening, attending his children's sporting events, and fishing local ponds. He is also a member of Trout Unlimited.

He is a member of Backcountry Hunters and Anglers and a founding member of MoKan Trout Unlimited.

Name: James Ulrick
Intro description: Hello 👋🏻, I'm James Ulrick, a Wealth Manager based in Colorado. While my career in finance began in 2005, my approach has always been different. With a background in Philosophy, I believe my most important job isn't just to manage assets, but to act as a 'wisdom broker', helping you connect your money to what is truly important. I help in guiding business owners, executives, and individuals through complex transitions, whether you are planning a business succession, optimizing equity compensation, or navigating life after a divorce. My favorite part of this work is helping clients build a resilient plan rooted deeply in what matters most to them. I have called Colorado home since 2012. You can often find me, my family and pup hiking the foothills, road cycling, or diving into books and movies.
Full description:
James is a financial advisor with nearly two decades of experience helping individuals, families, and business owners navigate complex financial decisions with clarity and confidence. His career began in 2005, working closely with small business owners to design and manage their company retirement plans. By 2008, he expanded his work to include active traders, but it was the financial crisis that truly reshaped his approach and solidified his purpose.

During that period, James saw something that fundamentally changed him: the clients who weathered the storm most successfully weren’t the ones making the most trades, they were the ones who had a deliberate plan and understood why they owned what they owned. That insight became the cornerstone of his philosophy and drives his work to this day: true financial confidence comes from having a resilient, goals-based plan, not from reacting to the markets.

He has called Colorado home since 2012. Outside of work, you’ll often find him and his family hiking the foothills, road cycling, or unwinding with a good book or movie, usually with their dog close by.

Name: Janelle Van Meel
Intro description:
Hello 👋🏼 I'm Janelle, I have over 25 years of experience in the financial industry specializing in retirement planning and I excel in identifying investment strategies and managing client portfolios, emphasizing personalized approaches without outsourcing portfolio management.

I don’t believe in a cookie cutter approach to investments, and work closely with my clients to identify the right strategy for them. I work with both public and private investments to help our high net worth clients build their portfolios.
Full description:
Janelle brings more than 25 years of experience in the financial services industry, having worked at national investment firms focusing on retirement planning, mutual funds, and portfolio management. She is experienced and is in identifying prudent investment strategies. Janelle has extensive background in researching stocks and bonds, and she takes pride in helping manage client portfolios.

"We buy individual securities and bonds ourselves, unlike other firms that "farm out" portfolio management,” she said. “There is no cookie cutter approach here, and it gives clients the chance to be part of the decision-making process as we customize their investments."

Outside of the office, Janelle has a passion for race cars and can be spotted watching the action at the racetrack. She owns a first-generation U.S., black, Honda Civic Type R which is her ride in the summer. Janelle's other devotion is to her family, and especially her more than 20 nieces and nephews.

Name: Jared Tanimoto
Intro description:
Hi there! 👋🏼 I’m Jared, a financial advisor based in Irvine, California with over a decade of experience helping clients make well-informed financial decisions to achieve their long-term goals. I’m passionate about diving into the intricacies of financial planning - whether it’s preparing for retirement, navigating investments, or optimizing tax strategies. I take pride in making complex topics easier to understand, so my clients feel confident and in control of their financial future.

I am a proud graduate from The University of California, Irvine (UCI) where I studied Business Economics, and the Executive Financial Planning program at The Graziadio School of Business at Pepperdine University, along with the Certified Financial Planner (CFP®). Outside of work, you’ll find me outdoors doing something fun with my wife Paige (who’s a CPA and economist) and my two kids. I love every kind of outdoor activity from backpacking and mountaineering to rock climbing, spearfishing and skiing. You might even find me on the golf course, if I’m looking for a little relaxation.
Full description:
Jared is a CERTIFIED FINANCIAL PLANNER® practitioner based in Irvine, California. He started his financial planning career in 2010, after graduating from the University of California, Irvine, as a financial services representative with several insurance based broker-dealers.

After many years, Jared felt like there was a major flaw in the system, in his opinion, it wasn’t designed to put the client first. As time went on, he wanted to transition out of selling commissionable products and securities. Jared decided to leave his sales commissions and incentive bonuses to become a pure fiduciary-based financial advisor.

Jared is also a proud graduate of The University of California, Irvine (UCI) where he studied Business Economics, and the Executive Financial Planning program at The Graziadio School of Business at Pepperdine University. Jared loves supporting his profession and giving back to the community. He found a way to do both by actively volunteering as a member of the Financial Planning Association (FPA).

Outside of work, you’ll find Jared outdoors doing something fun with his wife Paige (who’s a CPA and economist) and two kids, Quinn and Reid. He loves every kind of outdoor activity from backpacking and mountaineering to rock climbing, spearfishing and skiing. You might even find him on the golf course, if he’s looking for a little relaxation.

Name: Jason Craine
Intro description:
Hi there! 👋🏼 I’m Jason, a financial advisor based in Wichita, Kansas, with over a decade of experience helping my clients make well-informed financial decisions to reach their long-term goals. My passion lies in helping guide clients to understand and feel confident in their financial strategies, whether it’s planning for retirement, navigating investments, or optimizing tax strategies.

I hold a Bachelor of Science degree in Business Administration with an emphasis in Management Leadership from William Jewell College, along with the Certified Financial Planner (CFP®). Outside of work, I’m actively involved in our community and enjoy spending time with my family—my wife, Jessica and I have been blessed with two sets of twins and three dogs. In my spare time, you’ll find me woodworking, coaching kids’ sports, and cheering on the Kansas City Chiefs!
Full description:
Over the past decade, Jason has dedicated his career to helping families achieve their financial goals through comprehensive planning and personalized guidance. His journey in finance began in 2010, and since then, he has gained diverse experience in banking, investment management, accounting, insurance, and holistic financial planning. In 2019, Jason relocated with his family to Wichita, Kansas, to establish Mariner Wealth Advisors’ first office in the area, where he has spent the last ten years building a financial planning practice.

Jason holds a Bachelor of Science degree in Business Administration with an emphasis in Management Leadership from William Jewell College, along with the Certified Financial Planner (CFP) designation and several additional industry credentials. These qualifications reflect his dedication to continuous professional development and providing clients with high-quality, informed advice.

Outside of work, Jason is deeply involved in his community, serving on the Board of Directors for Exploration Place, the Andover YMCA, and the Financial Planning Association (FPA) of Kansas, as well as on a council for our local elementary school. Giving back is a priority for Jason, and he is grateful for the opportunity to contribute to organizations that make a difference.

Name: Jeff Brimhall
Intro description: I’m Jeff Brimhall PhD, CFP®, CFA, a Managing Partner at Blue Barn Wealth, where I helps clients simplify their financial lives and align their wealth with what matters most. As a former Chairman of the Utah Chapter of the Financial Planning Association and university instructor in personal financial planning, I bring academic depth and real-world experience to every client relationship.
Full description:
Jeff Brimhall is a managing partner at Blue Barn Wealth, where he enjoys working with clients to simplify their life and master their finances. Prior to Blue Barn Wealth, Jeff served as a Senior Advisor at Soltis Investment Advisors and acted as interim CEO of Ampelis, a corporate and family consulting company focused on successful transitions of culture and assets between generations.

Earlier in his career, Jeff was an award-winning faculty member in Finance and Economics at Case Western Reserve University, an equity analyst in National City Bank’s Private Client Group, and held analyst and advisory roles at Lee Financial, a Registered Investment Advisor in Dallas, TX, and Crow Holdings.

Jeff earned a PhD in Economics from Southern Methodist University and a B.S. in Civil and Environmental Engineering from Brigham Young University. He is a CERTIFIED FINANCIAL PLANNER™ professional and holds the Chartered Financial Analyst designation. Jeff has also served as Chairman of the Utah Chapter of the Financial Planning Association and taught in the Personal Financial Planning Program at Utah Valley University.

Name: Jeff Peller
Intro description: Hello there 👋🏼 I’m Jeff Peller, a Wealth Manager with over 25 years of experience striving to make a positive impact helping clients manage their wealth. My passion lies in helping others work through “transitions” in their lives, including business sales, divorce, retirement, and special needs planning. All of my services are personalized and aided by the power of advanced technology to help provide an efficient and seamless client experience.
Full description: Jeff Peller, CFP®, PFS, CPA, CEPA is a Wealth Manager well-versed in helping clients navigate transitions like business sales, divorce, retirement, and special needs planning. He draws from the wisdom of his experiences starting and exiting a business, raising a special needs child, navigating a divorce, and retiring early. Ultimately, he’s passionate about the opportunity to make a positive impact in people’s lives both financially and beyond.

Name: Jenna Smith
Intro description:
Hi 👋🏼 I’m Jenna. I work with individuals and families who want to be intentional with their money and make informed financial decisions.

My approach brings together financial planning and the behavioral side of money. I help clients understand how their habits, emotions, and experiences can influence financial decisions, then work with them to build a plan that fits their real lives. Whether we are discussing investments, retirement, taxes, insurance, estate planning, or cash flow, I want clients to understand their options and the reasoning behind each decision.
Full description:
Jenna Smith is a financial advisor who is passionate about helping individuals and families better understand the decisions they make with their money.

As an Accredited Financial Counselor (AFC®), Jenna brings a behavioral perspective to financial planning. She recognizes that a financial plan needs to work in a client’s day-to-day life, not simply on paper. Her work brings together investments, retirement, tax planning, insurance, estate planning, and cash flow while helping clients understand how each part connects.

Jenna’s interest in financial planning is personal. Growing up around financial stress showed her how strongly money can affect relationships and family life. When she discovered a career that would allow her to help people better understand their finances and make informed decisions, she knew it was the direction she wanted to pursue.

She has received the Charles Schwab RIA Talent Advantage Scholarship and the Charles Schwab CFP® Certification Scholarship. Jenna is also active in the financial planning community and has spoken at industry events including Wealth Management EDGE and Bob Veres’ Insider’s Forum.

Outside of work, Jenna enjoys traveling, running, skiing, attending industry conferences, and finding an excuse to spend time outdoors.

Name: Jennifer Gugliemotto
Intro description: Hi 👋🏼 I’m Jenny. I specialize in guiding clients through life’s transitions with compassion, clarity, and intentional planning—endeavoring to help build security, protect what matters, and live with possibility, especially through loss, retirement, and legacy planning.
Full description:
After a transformative 12-year career as a global corporate retail designer, Jennifer pivoted to financial planning, driven by a profound personal loss. This experience reshaped her purpose, leading her to become a wealth manager dedicated to offering comfort, clarity, and guidance to those navigating grief—particularly in matters of money, legacy, and family division.

With seven years of experience in financial planning, formerly with Edward Jones Investments and Huntington Bank, Jenny joined Savvy Advisors to embrace its tech-forward and client-focused model. Unbound by the limitations of traditional firms, she offers her services nationwide, combining flexible in-person meetings with convenient digital and online communication options. Deep, empathetic listening drives Jenny's creative investment solutions that build lasting relationships.

Jenny is actively involved with 4H, the Columbus Art Museum's fundraising efforts, and alumni associations for DAAP and Walnut Hills High School. In her free time, she prioritizes a balanced life, community connection, and personal growth through continued conversation.

Name: John Khoury
Intro description:
Hello! I’m John. My finance journey began at the University of Massachusetts, where internships at Fidelity Investments sparked my passion for financial planning and investing. After starting my career as a retirement consultant, I earned my master’s degree in Financial Planning from the University of Nebraska while gaining valuable industry experience.

This combination of education and hands-on work deepened my commitment to helping clients achieve their financial goals holistically. I spent seven years as a trusted financial advisor at Fidelity, followed by 15 years at Schwab, where I further honed my expertise.

Now, as a financial advisor at Savvy, with a fiduciary responsibility, I seek to provide cost-efficient, tax-smart advice, always putting my clients’ best interests first.
Full description:
John Khoury is a Principal Wealth Manager at Savvy and brings 20+ years of wealth management experience working with families, business owners, and organizations. He has a passion for providing fiduciary advice to his clients and helping them with complex wealth management. He specializes in transitions, such as retirement, business sales or other liquidity events, paying for college, divorce, and the loss of a loved one.

Joining Savvy in November 2023, John was VP Sr. Financial Consultant at Schwab for 15 years and VP Financial Consultant at Fidelity for 8 years. At Schwab, John worked with 400 high-net-worth families and organizations, with over $300M in advisory services.

John Khoury lives in Boston Metrowest with his wife and three children. In his free time, he enjoys sports, family time, and volunteering with his local educational and charitable organizations.

khouryprivatewealth.com

Name: Jonathon Merickel
Intro description:
Hi there! I’m Jonathon Merickel, CFP®, a Wealth Advisor based in Chicago, Illinois. For more than two decades, I’ve helped individuals, families, and business owners plan for retirement, navigate taxes, and build financial strategies that support both their goals and the realities of life.

I believe deeply in the fiduciary standard and treat every client with the same level of care and respect. Financial planning isn’t just about numbers; it’s about guiding people through every phase of life with clarity, consistency, and confidence.
Full description:
I’ve always loved helping people accomplish their goals. Financial advising is unique in that it allows me to work with individuals and families across every stage of life, from early accumulation years to retirement and beyond.

Over the years, I’ve seen firsthand how life rarely goes exactly according to plan. That’s why I believe great financial planning must be flexible, personal, and grounded in real human experience. My role is to help clients navigate both planned milestones and unexpected changes with confidence and clarity.

In addition to working with clients, I’m actively involved in the financial planning community and currently serve as a Board Member of FPA Illinois, supporting the profession and its future.

Name: Jordan Jensen
Intro description:
Hi there! I’m Jordan Jensen, a Private Wealth Advisor based in Dallas, Texas. I specialize in helping high-income professionals, particularly Law Firm Partners, navigate complex tax structures, income planning, and long-term wealth strategy.

With a background in trading and portfolio management, I take a holistic, timing-driven approach, integrating tax strategy, investment management, and retirement planning into one cohesive plan. My goal is to help clients gain clarity, confidence, and control over their financial decisions while building long-term relationships rooted in trust.
Full description:
I’ve always been drawn to working with money. Growing up, I witnessed very different financial realities within my own family, some with very little, others with significant wealth. In both situations, I saw how often money was mismanaged and the stress it created. At the same time, I also saw the opportunities and experiences that were possible when money was structured intentionally.

Those early experiences led me to financial advising, where I now help clients plan ahead around taxes, income, and major life decisions. I focus not just on the numbers, but on building lifelong relationships that seek to support both financial success and personal fulfillment.

Outside of work, I enjoy golfing, staying active, and spending time outdoors. My black lab, Maya, keeps me grounded and is a daily reminder to keep life balanced.

Name: Jordan Lauber
Intro description:
Hi there! 👋 I’m Jordan, a financial advisor who believes investment expertise only matters when it’s paired with thoughtful planning and real-life guidance. I work primarily with professionals and families in their peak earning years, helping them navigate big decisions — balancing career growth, family priorities, retirement planning, and long-term legacy goals. My approach centers on building clear, personalized strategies that integrate investment management, tax-aware planning, and long-term wealth design so clients can move forward with confidence, not uncertainty.

Outside of the office, I value the same discipline and balance I encourage in financial planning. I spend most of my time with my children, staying active through fitness training and golf, and continually investing in personal development. Habits that mirror the consistency and long-term mindset I bring to helping clients pursue lasting financial success.
Full description:
Jordan Lauber believes investment expertise only matters when it’s paired with thoughtful planning and real-life guidance. That belief drew him to financial advising…helping people make confident decisions during moments that often feel uncertain, complex, and deeply personal.

Jordan specializes in working with professionals and families in their peak earning and decision-making years. He helps clients navigate competing priorities such as career growth, family responsibilities, retirement planning, and legacy goals. His process centers on building clear, personalized strategies that connect wealth with purpose.

His approach is rooted in transparency, trust, and long-term partnership. Rather than focusing on products, Jordan collaborates with clients to develop customized plans that integrate investment management, tax-aware planning strategies, and long-term wealth design. Clients appreciate his ability to simplify complex financial decisions while keeping their broader life goals front and center.

Outside of the office, Jordan prioritizes time with his children and maintaining a balanced lifestyle. He enjoys fitness training, golf, and personal development — pursuits that reflect the discipline and consistency he brings to helping clients pursue long-term financial success.

Jordan is committed to turning financial complexity into a clear, confident path forward built on trust and lasting relationships.

Name: Josh Bergman
Intro description: Hi! I’m Josh Bergman, JD, CFA®, a financial advisor specializing in portfolio management, tax and succession planning, behavioral economics, managing concentrated positions, and sourcing alternative investments. Earlier in my career, I was a Trusts and Estates attorney, which is when I realized I am passionate about helping families navigate some of life’s most personal and complex decisions. As my career progressed, I was able to expand my expertise to financial planning and asset management, where I was part of a team that oversaw $4.5 billion of assets under management before launching my firm, JNB Wealth. Today, my goal is to work with both ultra-high-net-worth (“UHNW”) families as well as “everyday investors” who could use some help retiring a few years earlier, buying a little more house, or sending their child to a better school.
Full description:
Josh Bergman, JD, CFA®, is a Wealth Advisor based in Long Island, NY.

Before becoming a Wealth Advisor, Josh began his career as an attorney in the Corporate department of the law firm Simpson, Thacher & Bartlett LLP. He then transitioned into advising domestic and international UHNW individuals and families on income, gift and estate tax planning, business succession planning, and charitable giving as a Trusts & Estates attorney.

Prior to joining Savvy, Josh served as Vice President in the Wealth Management group of Allen & Company Investment Advisors, where his team of advisors managed approximately $4.5 billion of assets under management on behalf of UHNW individuals and institutional investors.

His overall career experiences make him remarkably unique. As a JD, CFA®, and someone with experience managing several billion dollars on behalf of individuals and institutions, he provides clients with broad-ranging advice that typically would require bringing in specialists from multiple disciplines.

Name: Joshua Barone
Intro description: I'm Joshua, a financial advisor from Reno, Nevada. As someone who co-founded and built a trust company and investment advisory firm from the ground up, I’m passionate about sharing the lessons I've learned on my financial journey of 30+ years to guide and empower clients to secure their financial futures. Using active macroeconomic quantitative and tax avoidance strategies, I mitigate risk and help families achieve lasting financial independence, acting as guardians for future generations. Trust, consistency, and accessibility are at the heart of all my long-lasting client relationships.
Full description:
Joshua grew up in Reno, Nevada, with a constant curiosity and avid observance of the world around him. This curiosity sparked his understanding of wealth management, always striving to read about and refine his financial models and investment strategies.

Joshua’s financial journey started from the ground up like many of his clients. After learning the ins and outs of the financial world, Joshua eventually co-founded a trust company in 1999 and a financial advisory firm in 2006.

Leaning on the experience he gained during his financial journey, Joshua is passionate about guiding others to build, preserve, and transfer their wealth with the same care and intention that helped him succeed. Whether it’s financial planning, investment management, or tax strategies, he provides an evidence-based approach built on macroeconomic analysis and quantitative research to safeguard your legacy for the next generation.

Outside of work, Joshua is passionate about family. Living in the adventure sports capital, he has many hobbies, including exploring the outdoors. He also has extensive knowledge of the food and wine industry.

Name: Joshua Joffe
Intro description:
Hi, I’m Josh. I work with individuals and families who want a clear plan and a steady partner when financial decisions start to feel heavy.

A lot of people think this work is about picking the right investments. Investing matters, but much of the real value shows up in the day-to-day questions that inform the investment decisions themselves. Questions like: Can I retire sooner than I thought? What should I do with my equity compensation? How do I balance saving, giving, and enjoying life without feeling like I’m making a mistake?

My job is to help you get organized, make sound decisions with the information we actually have, and stay disciplined when the noise gets loud.
Full description:
While Josh’s career in wealth management now spans over 20 years, he often jokes that he’s an accidental advisor. With a non-traditional background, his introduction to capital markets happened shortly after college, when he began his career as an equities trader. That experience sparked a deeper interest and passion for investing, and led him into private client portfolio management.

Josh later joined a leading global asset management firm, where he served in senior portfolio management roles. His early years coincided with the 2008 financial crisis, giving him firsthand exposure to risk, market stress, and the importance of discipline. That period shaped how he thinks about portfolio construction and long-term planning.

Over time, he realized he wanted to be closer to the people behind the portfolios. He earned his MBA while working full time and later obtained his CFP® certification. He then joined an independent wealth management firm, where he began engaging directly in financial planning alongside portfolio management.

Today, Josh works with a select group of high-net-worth and ultra-high-net-worth households, including business owners, executives, professionals, and families navigating liquidity events, concentrated equity exposure, retirement transitions, and multi-generational planning.

Josh is an inaugural member of the Nasdaq Advisor Council, where he provides perspective on portfolio strategies and industry innovation. He has been recognized among etf.com’s Top 100 Financial Advisors. Josh also serves as co-Chair of the Investment Committee at JKHA, the school his children attend.

Josh resides in Livingston, New Jersey, with his wife and two children. Outside of work, he volunteers as an EMT when time allows. Most of his free time, however, is spent with his family. He is deeply involved in his community and his children’s lives – balancing extra-curricular activities, sporting events, dance recitals, and more. Those moments are reminders that financial planning is ultimately about supporting the lives happening outside of a spreadsheet.

Name: Justin Ericksen
Intro description: I’m Justin Ericksen, CFP®, CFA, AFC®, an Advisor at Blue Barn Wealth, passionate about helping individuals and families build clarity and confidence around their finances. I combine comprehensive planning with disciplined investment strategy to support long-term success.
Full description:
Justin Ericksen is an Advisor at Blue Barn Wealth and a CERTIFIED FINANCIAL PLANNER™ professional. He also holds the Chartered Financial Analyst designation and earned a master’s degree in Financial Planning and Analytics from Utah Valley University.

Justin is passionate about finance and helping individuals succeed. He believes the most important things in life are spending time with the people you love and enriching the lives of others. His planning philosophy reflects those values—helping clients build financial strategies that support what matters most to them.

Outside of work, Justin enjoys spending time with his wife and siblings. His favorite activities include tennis, snowboarding, singing, and playing board games. Justin, his wife, and their dog live in Fairview, Utah.

Name: Kacie Schulz
Intro description:
Hi there! 👋🏼 I’m Kacie, a CERTIFIED FINANCIAL PLANNER™ professional and Enrolled Agent with more than a decade of experience in wealth management. I founded Fortify Financial to provide individuals and families with independent, fiduciary advice that brings investment, financial, and tax planning together. Throughout my career, I’ve helped hundreds of people—from those just beginning to build wealth to ultra-high-net-worth families—navigate important financial decisions with greater clarity and confidence.

Outside of work, I most enjoy spending time with my family, being active outdoors, and traveling to new places. These experiences continually remind me that financial planning is about far more than numbers—it’s about creating the freedom to spend your time on the people, experiences, and goals that matter most.
Full description:
Kacie Schulz MS, CFP®, EA, is a wealth advisor with more than a decade of experience helping individuals and families make thoughtful, strategic financial decisions. Her approach combines investment management, financial planning, and tax considerations to help clients bring greater clarity and intention to every part of their financial lives.

Kacie began her wealth management career at Merrill Lynch in 2013 and became a CERTIFIED FINANCIAL PLANNER™ professional in 2017. After transitioning to an independent firm in 2019, she earned a Master of Science in Family Financial Planning and deepened her commitment to providing advice grounded in each client’s best interests. In 2022, she founded Fortify Financial to deliver independent fiduciary guidance with a more personal, integrated approach. She later became an Enrolled Agent, expanding her ability to incorporate tax considerations into portfolio and planning decisions.

Throughout her career, Kacie has advised hundreds of individuals—from those beginning to build wealth to ultra-high-net-worth families. She works closely with business owners, executives, professionals, and multigenerational families, helping them navigate complex decisions involving retirement, investments, taxes, education planning, and legacy.

Outside of work, Kacie enjoys spending time with her family, being active outdoors, and traveling.

Name: Karsten Walker
Intro description: I’m Karsten Walker, an Advisor at Blue Barn Wealth with more than 30 years of experience as a financial educator and investment strategist. I specialize in helping educators, families, and young professionals build financial confidence and long-term success.
Full description:
Karsten Walker is a financial educator, curriculum developer, and investment strategist with over 30 years of experience helping individuals and families build financial confidence.

A champion of financial literacy, Karsten played a key role in shaping Utah’s statewide financial education initiative beginning in 2004. He has presented at national conferences including NAST, NEFE, and GFLEC and has received numerous awards, including Utah ACTE Marketing Teacher of the Year and the Lifetime Achievement Award for Business and Marketing Education.

A former Financial Literacy  teacher and Alpine School District CTE Program Specialist, Karsten brings a lifelong passion for education into his advisory work. As a retired Tier 1 pensioned teacher and Series 65 advisor, he has deep experience with URS pensions, 401(k)s, HSAs, and helping educators navigate rollovers from high-fee 403(b) plans.

Outside of work, Karsten enjoys hiking, reading, music, and strategy games. He and his wife, Julie, have three children.

Name: Katherine Fibiger
Intro description: Hi 👋🏼 I’m Katherine. I work with high-earning professionals and business owners who have built significant wealth and are now facing complex decisions around their transition into retirement. My approach centers on building a clear, tax-aware strategy that connects every part of your financial life. From income planning and investment decisions, to healthcare and estate planning, each step is designed with intention so you can move forward with clarity and confidence.
Full description:
Katherine Fibiger brings more than two decades of experience helping clients navigate the transition into retirement. Her work focuses on designing income strategies that support long-term lifestyle needs while carefully considering taxes, market conditions, and evolving priorities.

She was drawn to financial planning early on through her love of analysis and teaching. Today, she blends those strengths by helping clients understand not just what decisions to make, but why those decisions matter within the bigger picture.

Katherine specializes in retirement income planning, tax-aware strategies such as Roth conversions and withdrawal sequencing, and coordinating decisions across investments, healthcare, and legacy considerations. Her goal is to create a cohesive plan that reflects each client’s unique situation and supports them through every stage of retirement.

She values building long-term relationships and takes pride in guiding clients through one of the most important financial transitions of their lives with care and attention.

Name: Keith Hamberg
Intro description:
Hi, I’m Keith Hamberg. I’m a Certified Financial Planner™ based in Cincinnati, OH, and I help individuals and families navigate taxes, retirement planning, and financial decision-making without the stress and confusion that often comes with it. My goal is to take complex financial topics and turn them into practical, understandable steps that make sense for your life.

Outside of work, I’m a husband and dad of two. I enjoy exploring the city with my family, chasing after my kids, and finding ways to make everyday life a little more fun.
Full description:
Keith Hamberg is a Certified Financial Planner™ based in Cincinnati, OH, with more than a decade of experience helping clients navigate taxes, retirement planning, and comprehensive financial strategies. He focuses on translating complex financial topics into practical, understandable steps, allowing clients to feel organized and informed as they make important financial decisions.

Keith’s approach is centered on clarity, simplicity, and collaboration. He works closely with individuals and families to align strategies around their unique goals, whether that involves retirement planning, investment management, tax optimization, or estate and trust planning.

Outside of work, Keith is a husband and father of two. He enjoys spending time with his family, exploring Cincinnati, and keeping up with the busy, fun pace of family life.

Name: Ken Bobadilla
Intro description:
Hello 👋🏼 I’m Ken. I help retirees, families, and small business owners plan for the future with clarity and confidence. With nearly three decades of experience in financial services, I focus on estate planning, retirement planning, and business exit strategies, but above all helping clients make informed decisions that help protect what they’ve built and ensure their legacy is carried out with care.

My approach is deeply personal and educational. I take time to understand each client’s goals, family dynamics, and long-term vision, then design customized strategies for everything from structuring trusts to transitioning a business. I believe in empowering clients to enjoy what they’ve earned and preserve what they’ve saved for the next generation.
Full description:
Ken brings nearly three decades of experience in financial services, specializing in estate planning, retirement strategies, and business exit planning. He works primarily with retirees, families, and small business owners, helping them navigate major life transitions and build plans that reflect their goals and values.

Before becoming a financial advisor, Ken spent 25 years as a professional sailor and business owner, operating a successful boat rental business in Hawaii and San Diego. That experience taught him the importance of independence, discipline, and long-term planning—principles he now applies to his work with clients every day.

Ken takes an educational, relationship-driven approach to financial planning. He helps clients design customized strategies for estate transitions, business exits, and legacy planning, with a special focus on family dynamics and trust structures. His philosophy is simple: help people enjoy what they’ve earned and thoughtfully pass on what they’ve saved.

Ken resides with his wife, who works professionally in trust management, giving him an even deeper perspective on estate and legacy planning. When he’s not working with clients, he enjoys being on the water, reflecting his lifelong connection to sailing and adventure.

Name: Kevin Beutel
Intro description: Hi there! I’m Kevin Beutel, a Wealth Manager and a FEEBA Certified Federal Retirement Consultant specializing in helping federal employees with retirement. With clients, I pride myself on simplifying complex financial concepts and breaking them down into clear, actionable steps. My passion lies in promoting financial literacy, with a key focus on establishing sound financial habits, developing effective budgeting strategies, and mitigating risks for a secure retirement. Together, my clients and I develop a deeper understanding of the factors that drive financial success and create a personalized plan to build a successful future.
Full description:
Kevin Beutel, MBA, is a dedicated Wealth Manager in Albany, NY. His passion for financial guidance was sparked while working as a controller for an excavating company. Volunteering to teach a financial literacy course for a local nonprofit revealed his deep satisfaction in educating others and helping them achieve their next financial milestones.

Inspired by this experience, and having witnessed the significant financial challenges and lack of professional guidance faced by the blue-collar workers at the excavating company during the 2008 financial crisis, Kevin launched his career as a financial advisor. He subsequently returned to school to earn an MBA with a Master’s Level Certificate in Financial Planning.

Early in his career, he also assisted several federal clients with their taxes, which motivated him to specialize in navigating the complexities of federal benefits.

In 2025, Kevin joined Savvy. He was drawn to the firm's technology, which allows him to streamline administrative tasks and dedicate more personal time to assisting clients. Outside the office, Kevin enjoys the natural beauty of Upstate New York through activities like woodworking, gardening, hiking, and occasional kayaking with his wife.

Name: Kristin V Dunlevy
Intro description: Hi there, I'm Kristin, Institutional Investment Advisor with over 28 years of experience. I’m passionate about helping organizations and their employees achieve their financial goals through retirement planning. I specialize in designing employer-sponsored retirement plans, guiding mid to large-sized companies through complex regulations with clarity and care.
Full description:
Based in Louisville, KY, Kristin Dunlevy is an institutional investment manager at Savvy, specializing in employer-sponsored retirement plans. With a mathematics degree and early experience at her parents’ CPA firm and working on the 400+ acre family dairy farm, she found her calling as a fiduciary advisor, simplifying the complex so we all can aim to prosper.

Kristin serves mid- to large-sized organizations with 50–5,000 employees, designing competitive retirement plans that prioritize employees and help mitigate regulatory risks. As a plan advocate, she optimizes provider relationships, negotiates fees, and aims to drive results.

At Savvy, Kristin values the freedom to focus on empowering clients. She holds CPFA and AIF® designations, is a Chicago Booth CIMA® Executive Education graduate, and serves on the NAPA Government Affairs Committee.

Her mission: “Through Awareness, Inspiration, and Determination, anyone can Prosper—at work and play.”

Name: Kurt Fetter
Intro description: Hi, I'm Kurt. For more than 20 years, I've worked with business owners, investors, and families to help them navigate important financial decisions. I focus on serving family-owned businesses and investors seeking thoughtful guidance around portfolio management, tax-aware planning, retirement preparation, and business succession.
Full description:
Kurt Fetter has spent more than 20 years helping business owners, investors, and families navigate important financial decisions. His career began with a focus on estate planning for successful farming families. While he enjoyed that work, he became increasingly interested in investment management and wanted to play a larger role in helping clients build and manage their wealth. That interest led him into the advisory industry, where he discovered a passion for building personalized investment strategies and helping clients work toward their long-term goals.

Today, Kurt focuses on serving family-owned businesses, business owners, and investors who are looking for personalized guidance around investments, retirement planning, and long-term financial goals. Many of his clients are preparing for significant life transitions, including retirement or the eventual sale of their business. His background includes investment management, stock selection, tax-aware planning, alternative investments, and business succession planning. He also has considerable experience helping business owners prepare for ownership transitions and business sales.

Kurt particularly enjoys helping business owners navigate both their company and personal financial lives, creating strategies that support their goals before, during, and after retirement. He helps clients build investment portfolios designed to support retirement goals while considering tax implications and long-term objectives. For business owners, he often assists with preparing a business for sale, organizing financial records, evaluating opportunities, and navigating the transition process from ownership to retirement.

For Kurt, the relationships are the most rewarding part of the work. He enjoys getting to know clients, learning about their families, businesses, and goals, and being part of important decisions throughout their lives. Over time, many client relationships grow beyond the professional level, which is one of the most gratifying aspects of what he does. Kurt holds an MBA and is based in New York, NY.

Name: Lauren Lindsay
Intro description: Welcome to Paragon Private Wealth Management! Financial Planning has been my career for 28 years and it is not just my job, it is my passion. I help my clients navigating life transitions make sense of their financial lives with clear, personal planning. Before becoming a financial planner, I was an English teacher. That background still shapes how I work today. I take the time to explain financial decisions in plain language, answer questions without judgment, and build plans that reflect each client’s goals, values, and real life.
Full description:
Lauren Gadkowski Lindsay began her career as a fee-only financial planner in 1998 and has been a Certified Financial Planner ® since 2001. She joined Paragon in 2025 and develops personalized strategies that reflect her clients’ goals and values across the country and internationally. Based in Houston, Texas, Lauren has worked virtually with clients since 2008, blending accessibility with highly personalized service. A former English teacher, she’s skilled at making complex financial topics clear and actionable.

Lauren is passionate about helping clients reach their goals through flexible, customized plans that adapt as life evolves. At Paragon, she focuses on building tailored solutions and guiding clients toward lasting success.

Lauren lives in Houston’s Woodland Heights with her husband, daughter, and St. Bernard. She’s active in her community as a school volunteer, Girl Scout leader,  and contributor to the Houston Heights Women’s Club. Her life reflects a deep commitment to family, clients, and service.

Name: Lee Levy
Intro description: Hi 👋🏼 I’m Lee Levy, a wealth manager based in Alamo, CA, with a background in trading and alternative investments. Before becoming an advisor, I spent over 15 years working with hedge funds, investment banks, and institutional clients — even running my own fund built on a rules-based strategy to remove emotion from investing. Today, I help high-net-worth individuals build risk-aware portfolios that align with their values and long-term goals. I became an advisor because I saw how hard it was to find one who truly put clients first — so I decided to become the kind of advisor I was always looking for
Full description:
