Lee Levy brings over 15 years of experience in the alternative investment space, where he worked closely with hedge funds, investment banks, and institutional clients as a trader and fund manager. His rules-based investment strategy was built to remove emotion from decision-making — an approach he continues to bring into his work as a wealth manager today. Based in Alamo, CA, Lee works with high-net-worth individuals who want long-term financial clarity without unnecessary risk, helping them align their portfolios with their goals, values, and the realities of the market.

Lee’s favorite part of his work is seeking ways to help clients shed financial stress, empowering them to focus on what truly matters in life.

Name: Lindsey K. Leaverton
Intro description: Hey y'all! I'm Lindsey - a Private Wealth Advisor who believes peace of mind isn't found in projections; it's built through partnership. I help clients turn financial complexity into clarity, designing personalized roadmaps that lead to real, sustainable freedom. I'm especially passionate about working with dynamic women ready to reclaim their financial power (or claim it for the very first time). My work blends the analytical and the intuitive: a neurodivergent, creative brain that sees patterns differently and an obsessive attention to detail that ensures nothing slips through the cracks. My approach is holistic and human, rooted in empathy, education, and collaboration. Because the best plans aren't built for you... they're built with you. After all, time is our greatest asset, and money's just the tool that buys us back the moments that matter.
Full description:
Lindsey K. Leaverton is an Austin-based Private Wealth Advisor at Savvy Wealth, specializing in financial planning and investment management for individuals and families who want to align their wealth with their values.

A proud Texan and Texas A&M magna cum laude graduate, Lindsey began her career leading a nonprofit as Executive Director while touring the country as a professional recording artist and speaker. Her passion for servant leadership led her to the financial services industry in 2010 where she quickly advanced from Personal Banker to Branch Manager and eventually helped launch Austin's first Private Bank for BB&T. There, she earned the National Sterling Award for excellence in leadership and client service.

Before joining Savvy Wealth, Lindsey served as Director of Wealth Management at a $1B Austin advisory firm, where she led client strategy and designed comprehensive financial plans for high-net-worth families.Recognized with the Austin Under 40 Award for Excellence in Financial Services and selected as a McBee Fellow with AARO, Lindsey also serves as Vice President of the Board for People's Community Clinic.

At Savvy, she helps clients find clarity and confidence through thoughtful financial planning, values-aligned investing, and tax-efficient strategies. She holds FINRA Series 7, 63, and 66 licenses, along with the AWMA® designation.

Outside of work, Lindsey lives in Cedar Park, TX with her twin teenagers and two rescue pups. Featured in outlets such as The New York Times and People Magazine, she's also an author, speaker, and singer. Her debut book, Not Another Self-Help Book, became as Amazon Bestseller in 2024. A lifelong creative, Lindsey believes that laughter - like money - is best when shared.

Name: Lindsey Lewis
Intro description:
Hi, I’m Lindsey👋🏼. I am a financial advisor serving clients in Salt Lake City, UT and Park City, UT, partnering with high-net-worth individuals/families, entrepreneurs, and professional athletes to simplify complex financial lives, guide high-stakes decisions, and build strategies that hold up through growth, change, and transition, for example, divorce.

Backed by more than a decade in wealth management and leadership at The American College of Financial Services, I combine deep technical knowledge with a modern, thoughtful approach to advice. I go beyond traditional planning to serve as a strategic thought partner, helping clients align their financial decisions with their long-term vision and what matters most to them.
Full description:
Lindsey Lewis, MBA, ChFC®, CFP®, is a Park City-based financial advisor with Blue Barn Wealth, known for helping clients simplify complex financial lives and make confident decisions through moments that matter most. She works with high-net-worth individuals and families, entrepreneurs, and professional athletes, guiding them through growth, success, and transition with clarity, structure, and intention.

In addition to her advisory work, Lindsey serves as Managing Director at The American College of Financial Services, where she is focused on shaping the future of financial advice and developing the next generation of professionals. She also contributes to Advisor Launch Lab, supporting the development of advisors as they build and grow their practices. Her work has earned national recognition, including InvestmentNews Hot List in 2025 and 2023, as well as the InvestmentNews Trailblazer Award and other industry honors recognizing her impact on the profession.

Outside of her professional work, Lindsey brings the same level of energy and intention to her personal life. She is a mom of two, a yoga teacher, and someone who prioritizes strength, movement, and balance, values that carry through to how she approaches both life and wealth.

Name: Louis Green
Intro description:
Hi there 👋🏼 I'm Louis, I believe in creating comprehensive written financial plans tailored to my clients' needs, covering all aspects of their financial well-being, and ensuring sufficient liquidity for continued investment during market volatility.

My expertise lies in assisting clients in preparing for significant life milestones such as retirement, inheritance, wealth transfer, or business transitions. I also specialize in collaborating with executives on restricted stock, stock options, and strategic planning.
Full description:
Louis is dedicated to helping his clients solve the financial puzzle of their lives. He focuses on long-term planning and comprehensive wealth management for attorneys, business executives, retirees, and trustees. Louis incorporates the lessons of behavioral finance into his work. He believes that by avoiding emotional mistakes, particularly during times of financial upheaval, clients can be better positioned to achieve their goals. Louis’s approach to wealth management seeks to address each client’s day-to-day liquidity needs, retirement income goals, and the longer-term legacy they wish to create.

He has earned advanced certifications including the Chartered Financial Analyst®, Certified Financial PlannerTM designations. This training enables Louis to provide sound advice in many areas, including cash flow management, investment management, retirement planning, trust and estate planning, and tax mitigation.

Louis became interested in financial services at a young age while watching his father, an accountant, provide tax services to friends and family. Reading about Warren Buffett and other great stock pickers added to his fascination with the markets. He started his career in 1997 at Bankers Trust. The firm was purchased by Deutsche Bank, where Louis worked as a portfolio analyst and then as a portfolio manager. He joined PNC Wealth Management as an investment advisor in 2015 and moved to UBS in December 2020. Louis founded Prestiq Wealth Partners and joined Savvy Wealth in 2024.

M.B.A., finance, Zicklin School of Business, Baruch College – B.A., English, St. Francis College, Brooklyn, NY – Chartered Financial Analyst® (CFA®) – Certified Financial PlannerTM professional.

Name: Luis Miletti Jr.
Intro description: Hello there! I’m Luis Miletti Jr., a Wealth Manager specializing in retirement income planning, risk management, and tax optimization. I’ve been in the financial space for two decades, serving as an advisor for 15 years. With a passion for serving people and helping them achieve financial goals, I founded Miletti Wealth Management with the intention to provide a client experience unrestricted by the potential of biased firms. Behavioral finance is at the center of all of my client interactions, allowing me to help my clients make better financial decisions. I believe that you are more than just the numbers on your statements!  A good financial advisor takes their time to understand your “why” and help you build the appropriate plan to reach your financial goals.
Full description:
Luis Miletti Jr., CIMA®, CRPC® is a Wealth Manager and founder of Miletti Wealth Management.

With an early interest in math and a desire to help people, Luis realized that finance would provide the perfect opportunity to blend his passions. During his preparation as a Certified Investment Management Analyst ®, he started learning about behavioral finance. These lessons have become a central component of Miletti Wealth Management by helping people understand why certain decisions may or may not be in their best interest.

Outside of work, Luis is married to his wife Yadira, and they have four wonderful children. Luis loves to learn. He’s an avid documentary watcher of everything from history to science.

Name: Luis Rosa
Intro description: Hello, I'm Luis. I work with Latino executives who've built serious careers and need a wealth strategy sophisticated enough to match — equity compensation, tax strategy, and long-term planning, guided by someone who understands both the technical side and the experience of being first.
Full description:
I came to the U.S. from the Dominican Republic at age 11. As an immigrant, I had to learn two languages: English, and money — and there was no one at home who could teach me the second one.

That's exactly why I do this work today. Most of the Latino executives I work with are also the first in their family to reach this level — the first to navigate equity comp, the first with a real estate portfolio, the first making decisions with no blueprint to follow. I know that experience firsthand, and I bring real technical depth to match it.

My parents instilled hard work and education as the path forward, and I've built my practice around that same belief — except now, "success" isn't just the goal. It's the starting point we build a strategy from.

Name: Luis Villavicencio
Intro description: Hi there 👋🏼 I’m Luis Villavicencio, and I help clients build clarity and confidence around their finances. With over a decade of experience on the institutional and operational side of the industry, I bring a deep understanding of markets, products, and strategy into every client relationship. I specialize in working with young professionals, business owners, entrepreneurs, and those seeking faith-based planning, delivering education-first financial planning. I don’t believe in one-size-fits-all solutions– my approach is centered on your life, your values, and your goals, evolving over time so you can move forward with purpose and peace of mind.
Full description:
Luis Villavicencio is an Associate Wealth Manager with Savvy Advisors, bringing a global perspective and over a decade of experience across multiple facets of the financial services industry.

Originally from Venezuela, Luis relocated to the United States at age 19. He pursued his higher education at the University of South Florida, earning degrees in Economics and Management. His professional career began at Raymond James, where he spent ten years in money manager tTrading sSupport. During this time, he developed a deep understanding of financial markets while embracing a strong service-first culture that continues to shape his client-focused approach.

Luis later joined Independent Financial Partners, where he spent three years gaining valuable insight into the inner workings of the independent advisory business, including advisor operations, platform structure, and client service models. He then expanded his expertise at OneAmerica Securities, spending a year focused on life insurance, annuities, and alternative investments, further broadening his ability to address complex financial needs.

Today, as an Associate Wealth Manager with Savvy Advisors, Luis leverages cutting-edge technology and open-architecture solutions to deliver thoughtful, personalized strategies designed to help clients pursue their long-term financial goals with clarity and confidence. Additionally, Luis works with both English and Spanish speaking clients.

Name: Mark Tassie
Intro description: I’m Mark, a financial advisor from Larchmont, New York. I bring nearly two decades of market experience and a steady, thoughtful approach to long-term wealth management. After 17 years as a trader, I now work with high-net-worth families and business owners to simplify complexity, manage risk, and build wealth designed to last for generations.
Full description:
Mark is a financial advisor who brings together nearly two decades of market experience and a deeply personal approach to long-term wealth management. Before becoming an advisor, he spent 17 years as a trader, developing the discipline, risk awareness, and analytical mindset that now anchor his planning work with clients.

He partners with high-net-worth families, business owners, and multi-generational households, helping them simplify complexity, preserve what they’ve built, and make confident decisions about the future. His philosophy is inspired growth that is patient, deliberate, and built to last for generations.

He lives in Larchmont, NY with his family and is active in the local community, including youth sports programs. He joined Savvy to build a boutique advisory practice with modern tools, a collaborative culture, and a commitment to exceptional client service.

Name: Matt Nelson
Intro description: Hi there! I’m Matt Nelson, a Wealth Manager from Minneapolis, MN, helping high earners, business owners, and MedTech professionals create an income plan for equity compensation and retirement, from executives to high-earning employees and consultants. As the Founder and Managing Partner of Perspective 6 Wealth Advisors, I lead a team of dedicated wealth managers who provide comprehensive and personalized financial planning and investment management services to our clients. Ultimately, I’m passionate about clients experiencing a sense of relief and calm as we help clarify and achieve their financial goals.
Full description:
Matt Nelson is a Wealth Manager from Minneapolis, MN, and Founder of Perspective 6 Wealth Advisors. Matt got his start in the financial industry in 1998 with a mutual fund company, American Century. Early in his career as an advisor, he experienced navigating clients through the 2000-2002 technology crash, the 2008 financial crisis, and multiple market highs and lows. In 2006, he became an independent financial advisor with Focus Financial Network and founded Perspective 6 Wealth Advisors in the same year.

Today, Matt’s team works with employees with stock compensation in both private and public companies, as well as consultants and business owners. They place special emphasis on serving the MedTech industry, as they are familiar with their specific needs. His team also helps those who are retired or soon-to-retire navigate the next phase of their life. Their expertise ranges across stock compensation planning, tax mitigation, retirement planning, and investment management.

Outside of work, Matt enjoys being active, including bicycle racing for the team he co-sponsors, Peace Coffee Racing, skiing, and snowboarding. He also loves spending time with his wife, Taunya.

Name: Matt Powell
Intro description:
Hi there 👋🏼 I’m Matt, and I am dedicated to helping optimize clients' investments by offering personalized financial planning strategies. With an area of expertise centered around philanthropy, my goal is to support my clients' long-term financial success by providing continuous education and guidance.

With my focus on charitable giving and business succession planning, I enjoy helping clients who want to give back by designing financial strategies that align with their values while also achieving their personal goals.
Full description:
Matt facilitates a client-centric wealth management experience customized to his clients. With over 20 years of experience in the industry, he provides continuous guidance through ongoing management to help achieve client goals.

Before working with Savvy, Matt was a founding partner of True Harvest Private Wealth. He completed his business degree at Olivet Nazarene University, and holds the Chartered Financial Consultant® and CERTIFIED FINANCIAL PLANNER™ designations, both of which he received through a program with American College.

Matt works with clients spanning the Chicago area to Colorado. He takes a hands-on approach while upholding charitable giving planning as a central focus. Giving back is a driving force behind most of his strategic recommendations to spread goodness alongside supporting clients’ financial stability.

While originally from Chicago, Matt currently resides in Colorado with his wife and three sons. He is active in his community, serving as the Chairman of the Fire Foundation of Colorado Springs, a member of the El Paso County Bar Association, and a member of the finance committee at his church. In his personal life, Matt is active in his church and supports missions related to Haiti. He also enjoys hiking, surfing, roasting coffee and spending time with his family.

Name: Matt Versage
Intro description:
Hi, I’m Matt. I’m a financial advisor in Tampa, Florida. I work with high-net-worth families and business owners on retirement, investment strategy, and long-term wealth planning.

Most of my clients come to me with several financial decisions in motion at once and no single place where those decisions connect. That is the work I do: envisioning how all the pieces fit together, building one coordinated plan, and then executing on it.
Full description:
Matt Versage’s interest in wealth management  began when he watched someone close to him leave a large bank to build an independent practice. What stood out was not the business decision. It was how differently the client conversations went once an institution was not setting the agenda.
That shaped how he practices today. Matt maps the full financial picture before proposing anything: what is owned, where it sits, how it is taxed, and who it eventually passes to. Plans built before that work tend to solve for one account instead of the whole household.

As a CFP® professional, he brings a planning framework to conversations that often start as investment questions. How something should be invested usually depends on factors that have nothing to do with the portfolio.

Much of his work involves decisions that touch more than one person. A business owner weighing a sale. Parents coordinating with adult children. Assets spread across accounts and entities with different tax treatment. His role is to hold those pieces in view at the same time, so a choice that looks right on its own does not create a problem somewhere else.

Name: Matthew Conley
Intro description: Hi there, I’m Matthew, and I help individuals and families bring clarity and purpose to their financial lives. I offer comprehensive financial advising beyond just investments — focusing on your full financial health, with a holistic view of where you are now and where you want to go.
Full description: Matthew is an Associate Wealth Advisor at Colorado Wealth Group. Matthew graduated with his BA in Finance with a certificate in Business Law from the University of Cincinnati. He brings with him experience in the financial services industry and holds his Series 65 and the CERTIFIED FINANCIAL PLANNING (CFP®) designation. He is thrilled to have joined the CWG team where he can continue learning and get to know the clients. Outside of work, Matthew moved to Colorado in late 2022 from Cincinnati, Ohio. He spends his time skiing in the winter, and in the spring/summer he enjoys hiking, camping and golfing, but once fall comes around it is all about his Cleveland Browns.

Name: Matthew Finley
Intro description: Hi there! I’m Matthew Finley, CFP®, a Wealth Manager from Minneapolis, MN, specializing in investment management, tax planning, and income planning for retirement. As a former research microbiologist with several patents, I take a detailed and research-oriented approach to planning and selecting investments for my clients. I’m passionate about forming long-standing relationships and building trust with clients, so they can have peace of mind to focus on what matters most in their lives.
Full description:
Matthew Finley, CFP®, a Wealth Manager from Minneapolis, MN, specializes in active investment management, tax planning, and income planning for retirement.

The inspiration for his career in the financial industry came from conversations with his grandfather as a young boy. While these discussions about the stock market planted a seed in Matthew, he started off his professional career as a research microbiologist working on the antimicrobial properties of chemicals in the health and food safety industries. During this time, Matthew worked on numerous well-known products in the marketplace and has four patents. After his science career, Matthew moved into the sales and finance field, working for one of the largest credit processing companies in the country while developing numerous business relationships in the Midwest region.

With a strong desire to help people financially, Matthew began his financial career in 2009 with a large broker-dealer in Minneapolis, MN, where he learned the breadth of the financial markets and financial planning principles through an extensive training and research curriculum. In 2013, Matthew moved to the independent financial advisor model to better serve his clients as a fiduciary and become an expert in financial planning and asset management. In 2018, Matthew Finley joined the Perspective 6 Wealth Advisors team as a Partner & Financial Advisor to continue his pursuit of financial planning and asset management while collaborating with a highly successful team.

Beyond the world of finance, Matthew is passionate about spending time with his family, including his three children. He is actively coaching traveling baseball and acts as a part-time caddie for his daughter’s burgeoning golf career. When his time is not consumed with sports activities, he enjoys traveling to warm sandy destinations with his wife, Julie.

Name: Michael Gaynor
Intro description: Hello, I’m Mike, and I seek to help optimize clients' investments by offering personalized financial planning strategies. I’ve spent over 17 years as an option trader and continue to share my knowledge on finance and the markets now as a financial advisor. With my area of expertise on 401(k)s, option trading, and risk management, I am passionate about helping my clients achieve their financial goals.
Full description:
Mike has loved all things finance for as long as he can remember. In his opinion, being an option trader was one of the best jobs in the world. However, looking back, he found the work to be somewhat unsatisfying. He became a financial advisor to share his financial knowledge and passion with others. Mike views himself as a steward of his clients’ finances and cherishes the responsibility of guiding them toward their financial goals, and through continued education and hard work, he is committed to helping his clients achieve their aspirations.

With his transition to the wealth management industry, Mike leans on the financial knowledge he obtained from spending the first 17+ years of his career as an independent market maker on the floor of the Chicago Board of Trade (CBOT). In his previous experience, Mike truly learned the risks vs rewards that are involved in investing. He has also gained valuable customer relationship experience through being a small business owner, EcoGreen lawn services. Mike was a graduate of NIU, where he received his business degree.

On a day-to-day basis, Mike is busy staying up to date on volatile market conditions. He believes his knowledge and dedication to following historical and current market trends will directly benefit his clients.

Outside of the office, Mike is a dedicated husband and father. He is an active member of Red Rocks church serving as a greeter. His desire to help others recently led him on a mission trip to Honduras with All God’s Children, which profoundly shaped his perspective on life's true purpose. His love for the outdoors spurred his move to Colorado, where he enjoys skiing, hiking, biking, pickleball, and cross-fit training. Originally from Chicago, Illinois. Mike currently resides in Highlands Ranch, Colorado with his wife Ali, their children, Max, Sophia, Dillon, and their dog Louie.

Name: Michael Henry
Intro description:
Hi, I'm Michael.

I help pre-retirees, business owners, and medical professionals navigate important financial decisions with thoughtful planning and personalized investment guidance. My focus is helping clients understand their options so they can make informed decisions that support their long-term goals.

Whether we're discussing retirement planning, Roth conversion strategies, long-term care planning, or investment management, I believe education is one of the most valuable tools we can provide. I strive to create an environment where clients feel heard, confident, and prepared for whatever comes next.
Full description:
Michael Henry is a Wealth Advisor with a decade of experience helping individuals, families, and business owners build thoughtful financial strategies around life's biggest decisions. His practice focuses on comprehensive financial planning, retirement planning, investment management, and long-term care planning.

Michael's path into financial advising began after completing his MBA. Inspired by a close friend already in the profession, he realized he could combine his passion for helping people with his interest in financial planning. That career change allowed him to continue doing what he enjoys most: caring for others by helping them prepare for the future.

Today, Michael works closely with pre-retirees, business owners, and physicians to create personalized financial plans tailored to each client's goals. He believes education plays an important role in the planning process, helping clients better understand their options so they can make informed decisions with confidence.

Michael holds the Certified in Long-Term Care (CLTC) designation. He earned a Bachelor's degree from Liberty University's Helms School of Government before completing his Master of Business Administration.

Outside of his work with clients, Michael enjoys building lasting relationships and celebrating life's milestones alongside the families he serves.

Name: Michael Johnson
Intro description:
Hi, I’m Mike. I work with individuals and families navigating major financial events where taxes can have an outsized impact—from selling a business or appreciated real estate to taking a significant retirement distribution.

I specialize in event-driven tax mitigation, identifying opportunities to reduce unnecessary taxes before, during, and after these financial transitions. With more than 30 years of experience, I replace emotion with data and make complex strategies easier to understand.The goal is simple: help you make informed decisions, keep more of what you’ve built, and have a tax and investment strategy you understand and trust.
Full description:
Mike Johnson has over 30 years of experience as a fee-only investment advisor. He’s passionate about helping clients make great financial decisions rooted in data rather than emotion.

Mike is known for simplifying complex topics and removing the confusing jargon that often comes with financial planning. He believes that if you can’t explain something clearly, you don’t truly understand it, so he works hard to make every recommendation easy to follow and feel confident about.

He’s married and has four daughters (his oldest just started college). Outside of work, Mike loves spending time with his family skiing, mountain biking, and wake-surfing.

Name: Michael Lambrecht
Intro description: I’m Michael Lambrecht, a Wealth Manager based in Pleasanton, California. I began my financial career in 1982, and over the past four decades, I’ve built strong, lasting relationships with my clients based on trust, personalized guidance, and a deep understanding of their financial goals. My expertise spans a range of areas, including asset allocation, investment planning, and risk management, seeking to ensure that my clients’ portfolios are strategically designed to balance growth and protection. Whether navigating complex financial markets or planning for long-term wealth preservation, I’m committed to providing tailored solutions that help my clients achieve financial confidence and security.
Full description:
Michael Lambrecht is a seasoned Wealth Manager based in Pleasanton, California, with a financial career that spans over four decades. Since beginning his journey in the industry in 1982, Michael has dedicated his work to building strong, lasting relationships with his clients, rooted in trust, personalized guidance, and a keen understanding of their unique financial goals.

His expertise encompasses a wide range of financial areas, including institutional finance, asset allocation, investment planning, and risk management. By combining these skills, Michael seeks to ensure that his clients’ portfolios are strategically designed to achieve an optimal balance between growth and protection.

Michael's approach is deeply client-centered, offering tailored solutions that address the diverse needs of individuals, families, and businesses. His commitment to fostering financial confidence and security has made him a trusted partner for many, guiding them toward achieving their financial aspirations with clarity and peace of mind.

Name: Michael Most
Intro description:
Hello there 👋🏼 I'm Michael Most, and I've dedicated the past 27 years to the dynamic world of financial services. My journey began at American Express Financial Advisors, where I wore various hats, transitioning from Training Manager to District Manager and eventually finding my niche as a Private Wealth Advisor. In 2012, I was ready for a change and moved to LPL Financial, where I continued my role as a Private Wealth Advisor.

In August 2023, I embarked on a new chapter in my professional life by joining Savvy as a Principal Wealth Manager. This exciting move aligns perfectly with my passion for helping clients navigate the complexities of financial planning.
Full description:
Michael Most has dedicated the last 27 years to the ever-evolving landscape of the financial services industry. His professional journey commenced at American Express Financial Advisors, where he seamlessly transitioned from the role of Training Manager to District Manager, ultimately finding his niche as a Private Wealth Advisor. In 2012, he embraced a new chapter at LPL Financial, continuing his impactful work as a Private Wealth Advisor.

Beyond the numbers and charts, Michael is a devoted reader and perpetual learner, always seeking opportunities to expand his knowledge. Nature holds a special allure for him, and he finds solace in its beauty. When not immersed in the financial world, you're likely to find Michael on the tennis or pickleball court, where he thrives on the thrill of competition and the camaraderie it fosters. Michael's  journey of growth and fulfillment is driven by a genuine desire to make a positive impact on those around him.

Name: Michaela Sullivan
Intro description: Hi there! 👋🏼 I’m Michaela, I am dedicated to supporting my clients in retirement planning and major life transitions like divorce, retirement, bereavement, and liquidity events. I also focus on empowering women to navigate these changes, offering knowledge and guidance.
Full description:
Michaela, a Colorado native, earned her bachelor's in accounting in 2015. During her final year of college, she started working in the tax accounting field. Soon after graduation, she started working for a large financial firm in an accelerated career program designed to prepare her to become a financial advisor. Though she did not know much about finance when she began, she soon ended up becoming very passionate about the opportunity to do something that incorporated her growing financial knowledge while also being able to help people and make a difference in their lives through financial planning. In 2017, Michaela obtained her CFP® and became an associate financial advisor. She has been a financial advisor for over eight years and enjoys working with a dedicated practice of clients.

In her downtime, Michaela enjoys spending time with her dog and four charming felines, engaging in art, yoga sessions, and hiking.

Certifications
Series 65
Colorado Insurance license

Name: Mike Smith
Intro description: Hi! I’m Mike Smith, a Wealth Manager and Certified Exit Planning Advisor (CEPA®) passionate about helping families build wealth. A retired Army National Guard officer with 20+ years of service and 25+ years in the financial industry, I built my firm, FLEX Wealth Management, on the values I’ve carried through both careers: selfless service, doing the right thing at all times, and treating every client like family. FLEX stands for Family, Legacy, and EXperience — the pillars I use to help pre-retirees and business owners protect what they’ve built and leave the legacy they want. I prioritize diversification across portfolios and income streams, and I’m a firm believer in consistent, honest communication through the good times and the hard ones.
Full description:
Mike Smith, CEPA® is a Wealth Manager and Certified Exit Planning Advisor (CEPA®) specializing in financial, retirement income, and business succession planning. Service has defined his life on two fronts: over 20 years in the Army National Guard, from which he retired as an officer, and over 25 years guiding families through their financial lives.

Mike had an unconventional start. After college he joined an office furniture company, where he learned how a small business actually runs — sales, customer service, purchasing, and managing people. That experience gave him the itch to build and run something of his own, and a long-standing interest in investing led him to become a financial advisor in 1997.

After two decades advising clients, he founded his own firm, FLEX Wealth Management. Shaped by his faith and his military service, FLEX stands for Family, Legacy, and EXperience.

Mike is deeply rooted in his community — he has been an active member of BNI for most of his career and is involved with charities including the Ronald McDonald House and the Leukemia & Lymphoma Society.

Name: Nate Kunkel
Intro description: Hi there 👋🏼, I’m Nate and I primarily work with Procter & Gamble employees, retirees, and their families. I prioritize staying informed on all benefits for P&G employees to offer up-to-date and relevant advice. With a goals-first and consultative approach, I aim to provide tailored financial plans for each client and their families, focusing on genuine help over sales pitches.
Full description:
Nate is a Certified Financial Planner® and Wealth Advisor with nearly a decade of industry experience. His introduction to the world of financial advice began early in college at the University of Cincinnati through internships, where he discovered his passion and desire to work with families to achieve the retirements that they have worked so hard for.

Throughout his career, he has had the opportunity to work with many employees from Procter & Gamble, and have developed expertise helping clients with distribution strategies, options analysis & planning, and income planning in retirement.

Nate lives in Cincinnati in the Hyde Park area with his wife, Abby. In his time away from work, he enjoys running, cycling, tennis, and cheering on the Cincinnati sports teams.

Name: Nate Parker
Intro description:
Hi, I’m Nate. I’m an Associate Wealth Advisor with Rik Saylor Financial, where I help families and individuals work through investment planning, retirement strategy, and the financial decisions that come with life transitions.

I tend to bring a steady, analytical approach to planning. I like digging into the details, but I also believe financial guidance needs to be understandable and personal. My goal is to help clients see how the pieces fit together so they can make informed decisions based on their circumstances and what matters to them.
Full description:
Nate Parker joined Rik Saylor Financial in July 2016 and has grown into an important member of the advisory team. His work focuses on helping families and individuals navigate investment planning, retirement strategy, and financial decisions surrounding life transitions.

Nate earned his degree in Business Economics from the University of Cincinnati and obtained his Series 65 in 2023. He combines an analytical mindset with a calm, personable communication style. He is intentional about understanding the details of a financial decision rather than rushing to an answer, and he works to make those details understandable in the context of a client’s broader plan.

For Nate, strategy and service go together. He values meaningful client relationships and approaches his work with an emphasis on being genuine, intentional, and dependable.

Outside of the office, Nate enjoys spending time with his wife, Mollie, their two daughters, and their Husky, Kiana. He is a UC basketball season-ticket holder, attends Broadway in Cincinnati, and enjoys music and time with his family.

Name: Nathan Mirizzi
Intro description: I’m Nathan Mirizzi, an Associate Advisor and CERTIFIED FINANCIAL PLANNER™ professional at Blue Barn Wealth, passionate about helping individuals build clarity and confidence around their financial future. I bring energy, analytical focus, and a strong foundation in personal finance to the clients I serve.
Full description:
Nathan is a CERTIFIED FINANCIAL PLANNER™ professional and Associate Advisor at Blue Barn Wealth, where he work with individuals and families to bring clarity and structure to their financial lives. Many people reach a point where their finances become more complex—investments, taxes, career decisions, family planning, and long-term goals. His role is to help simplify those decisions and build a thoughtful financial strategy that supports what matters most to them.

At Blue Barn Wealth, the team takes a comprehensive approach to financial planning that integrates investment management, tax-aware strategy, and long-term planning into one coordinated framework. Nathan is especially passionate about helping young professionals build strong financial foundations early so they can make confident decisions as their careers and families grow.

Outside of work, Nathan enjoys spending time outdoors hiking, skiing, camping, hunting, and fishing, and spending time with family and friends.

Name: Nick McLaughlin
Intro description: Hi there! 👋🏼 I’m Nick, with 20+ years in wealth management, I like to blend sophisticated strategies with personalized client experiences. I specialize in financial planning for all life stages, from early savings to retirement distribution. I also bring expertise in high-net-worth services, equity management, and municipal bonds.
Full description:
J. Nick McLaughlin counts 20+ years in the wealth management industry and holds a Series 65 license. Coming from a background in both institutional money management and the investment advisory space, Nick strives to commingle sophisticated strategies and planning with the professional client experience that delivers measurable value. Whether a client has a long runway before retirement or nearing the wealth distribution phase, Nick specializes in walking the client through the process of assembling a sound, yet flexible, financial plan that is updated regularly and adjusted as circumstances in life change.

An Orange County native, Nick grew up in Irvine and started his college experience at UCI before eventually transferring to Cal Poly San Luis Obispo. He earned his B.S. in Business Administration with a finance concentration.

Besides extensive experience working with high-net-worth individuals, Nick has worked as a stock and credit analyst, equity portfolio manager, and spent ten-years managing tax-exempt municipal bond portfolios.

Nick lives in the South Bay with his wife and two daughters. He is an avid skier, musician, and softball player.

Name: Nick Swanson
Intro description: Hi there! 👋🏼 I’m Nick, I have spent over a decade helping clients navigate retirement planning, investment management, and wealth-building strategies. I am dedicated to making the financial planning process approachable and above all empowering, aiming to give clients clarity and confidence as they plan for the future. My favorite part of my work is guiding my clients and their families toward the moment when they can step into retirement on their own terms. It’s why I love what I do. Outside of work, you can often find me on the golf course, coaching high school wrestling, or spending time with my wife, Cassidy, and my dog, Boone.

Name: Nicole Burdick
Intro description:
Hi, I'm Nicole.

I'm the founder of Money Maven Financial, where I help people, especially women, bring clarity and organization to their financial lives. I believe financial planning should feel approachable, thoughtful, and connected to the realities of everyday life.

Whether you're navigating a major life transition, planning for retirement, thinking about charitable giving, or simply trying to make sense of your financial picture, my goal is to help you understand your options and make informed decisions with confidence. I take time to get to know each client so together we can build strategies that align with your values, your goals, and the life you want to create.
Full description:
Nicole Burdick is the founder of Money Maven Financial and a financial advisor with more than a decade of experience helping clients organize their financial lives and make thoughtful financial decisions.

Her path into financial planning began long before she entered the industry professionally. In her early twenties, she volunteered as a financial literacy instructor and budget coach, discovering a passion for helping people build confidence around money. Before becoming a financial advisor, Nicole worked in real estate and later built a professional organizing business. Those experiences continue to influence how she works today. While she once helped people organize their homes, she now helps them organize their financial lives with the same thoughtful and practical approach.

Nicole advises clients on financial planning, investment management, retirement planning, tax-aware strategies, insurance, debt management, Social Security, and estate planning. She has a particular interest in legacy and charitable planning, helping clients create giving strategies that reflect their values while considering tax and estate planning opportunities.

She especially enjoys supporting clients through significant life transitions, including divorce, the loss of a spouse, inheritances, caregiving responsibilities, career changes, and becoming the primary financial decision-maker.

Nicole is also the author of The Money Maven Manual, where she combines practical education with visual tools that make financial concepts easier to understand. She is currently pursuing graduate studies in financial therapy and looks forward to incorporating those principles into her work with clients.

Based in Bellingham, Washington, Nicole works with clients across the country.

Name: Patrick Conroy
Intro description: Hi 👋🏼 I’m Patrick. I’m a Wealth Advisor based in New York, with about 20 years of experience in wealth management and a career rooted in financial markets, trading, and risk. I work with clients who want clear, steady guidance across investing, retirement planning, and the decisions that shape their financial lives.
Full description:
Patrick brings decades of perspective from across financial markets, trading, and wealth management. He began his career in financial services after graduating from Columbia University with a degree in Economics. Over the years, he held senior trading and leadership roles at firms including Merrill Lynch, Prudential, Credit Suisse, and Donaldson Lufkin Jenrette.

After spending much of his career on the institutional side, Patrick transitioned into advising because he wanted to work more directly with individuals and families, helping them connect day-to-day decisions with long-term goals. He supports clients with investment and risk management, retirement planning, and financial planning, with a focus on building portfolios thoughtfully while keeping an eye on risk and tax considerations.

Outside of work, Patrick is a lifelong learner with a deep interest in markets. He is married to his high school sweetheart, Karen, and they have four daughters, plus a grandchild, Finnegan. He enjoys skiing, golf, and keeping up with sports.

Organizations
Columbia Alumni Association, Leukemia & Lymphoma Society, St. Edwards Church

Name: Patrick Traverse
Intro description:
Hi, 👋 I’m Patrick. I work with business owners across the United States who want a clearer, more intentional approach to managing their finances.

I help entrepreneurs bring together cash flow, investments, and tax-aware planning so their personal and business finances work together. My approach is shaped by my early career as a professional hockey player, where I saw how hard it can be to find advice that looks at the full financial picture.
Full description:
Patrick Traverse is a Wealth Advisor with over a decade of experience working with entrepreneurs and business owners across the United States. His work centers on helping clients coordinate their business finances with their personal financial lives so they can make more intentional decisions about their money.

Patrick’s journey into financial planning began during his career as a professional hockey player. Early in his career, he realized he needed financial guidance that addressed more than investments. He wanted help understanding cash flow, taxes, and long-term planning decisions that influence how wealth is built over time. When he struggled to find that kind of guidance, he began learning these areas himself.

That experience shaped his perspective and ultimately led him into financial advising. Today, Patrick focuses on helping business owners build structured financial strategies that support both their personal goals and the growth of their businesses.

Patrick holds the CERTIFIED FINANCIAL PLANNER® (CFP®) designation, is an Enrolled Agent (EA) authorized to represent clients before the IRS, and holds the Certified Exit Planning Advisor (CEPA™) designation. These credentials support his work helping entrepreneurs plan for long-term financial growth, tax efficiency, and eventual business transitions.

Name: Quintin Sharpe
Intro description:
Hello there 👋🏼 I'm Quintin. I have over 8 years of experience in the industry and I specialize in crafting tailored strategies for retirement accounts, insurance planning, and business investments for my clients. With my approach, I strive to combine data-driven precision and empowering clients to build up their financial confidence, and I enjoy fostering meaningful connections with them along the way. My overall goal is to collaborate with my clients to break down complex financial decisions into straightforward, practical steps.

‍

Name: Rahul Sarin
Intro description: I'm Rahul Sarin, a financial advisor based in New York, New York. For more than two decades, I've worked with high-net-worth individuals, pre-retirees, and business owners to build wealth and create financial plans designed around their specific goals. My focus is on retirement planning, investment management, and tax-efficient strategies to help you optimize your financial picture. In addition, having lived and worked across India, the UK, and the US, I bring a cross-border perspective to helping clients build, manage, and transfer their wealth.
Full description:
Rahul Sarin is a financial advisor with more than two decades of experience advising families, entrepreneurs, senior executives, and business owners across global markets.

Rahul founded Risa Wealth LLC with the purpose of helping clients create financial prosperity with clarity, confidence, and peace of mind. Before founding Risa Wealth LLC, Rahul spent 13 years at Avendus Capital, where he was a founding member of its private wealth management business. Earlier in his career, he worked with Citibank's Non-Resident Indian Wealth Management business and also held roles at Merrill Lynch and Deutsche Bank. Over the course of his career, Rahul has worked extensively with Indian-origin individuals and families, helping them build, preserve, and manage their wealth.

Having lived and worked in India, the United Kingdom, and the United States, Rahul brings an international wealth perspective that is especially relevant for Indian American families with personal, financial, and family interests in both the U.S. and India.

Rahul earned his undergraduate degree from St. Stephen's College, Delhi, and his MBA from SP Jain Institute of Management & Research, Mumbai. He also completed the Senior Executive Leadership Program at Harvard Business School.

Rahul lives in New York with his wife and son, who is pursuing his undergraduate studies at the University of Chicago. Outside of work, Rahul's interests include yoga, meditation, and spending time with his family.

Name: Randy Long
Intro description:
Hi, I’m Randy. I work with business owners and their families to plan for retirement, estate and trust decisions, investment management, and business succession.

My background spans law, financial planning, exit planning, and portfolio construction, which helps me look at each client’s situation from several angles. I prefer deep, long-term relationships with a smaller number of clients where I can add meaningful value over time.
Full description:
Randy M. Long is the Founder of Long Family Office and BuildProveSell.com companies, and the creator of the BulletProof Exit Process. He works with business owners who want to create enduring family legacies, prepare their businesses for sale, or transition ownership to the next generation.

With more than 39 years in wealth management and over 30 years across law and finance, Randy brings a wide-ranging background to his work with clients. He practiced law in estate planning and business transactions for 25 years, has managed family wealth for clients since 1987, and earned his Certified Financial Planner designation from the University of Southern California.

Randy is also the author of BulletProof Your Exit and The BraveHeart Exit: 7 Steps to Creating Your Family Business Legacy. Outside of his advisory work, he has served as a trustee, board member, and consultant for national Christian nonprofits. He and his wife, Lydia, have raised five children while growing their own family businesses, giving him personal perspective on the balance between business success, family, and legacy.

Name: Rik Saylor
Intro description:
Hi, I’m Rik. I’ve spent more than four decades helping individuals, families, and business owners think through the decisions that shape how they make, keep, use, and ultimately pass on their wealth.

I founded Rik Saylor Financial in 1996 with a straightforward philosophy: listen first, look at the whole picture, and turn good ideas into action. My work spans financial planning, investment management, tax planning considerations, estate and trust planning, and business succession planning. I believe straight talk makes complicated decisions easier to understand, and financial planning should ultimately support one thing: helping you pursue your best life.
Full description:
Rik Saylor started Rik Saylor Financial in 1996 and has built his career around helping families and business owners address the interconnected decisions involved in growing, using, and transferring wealth. With 43 years of wealth management experience, he takes a holistic approach that combines financial strategy with execution.

Listening comes first. Rik believes understanding a client’s circumstances, priorities, family, and business interests is essential before deciding what should happen next. His planning process can involve investment management, tax considerations, protection planning, estate and trust planning, and succession planning. For business owners, his CEPA designation also informs his work around exit and succession considerations.

Collaboration is another important part of Rik’s approach. RSF works alongside CPAs, insurance professionals, attorneys, and other professionals to help coordinate the different pieces of a client’s financial life.

Rik holds the Series 66 as well as life, health, and annuity insurance licenses and the Certified Exit Planning Advisor designation. He has supported organizations including Hospice, the Joe Nuxhall Character Education Fund/Miracle Fields, the Yellow Ribbon Program, and Wounded Warriors. He was named Fairfield Chamber of Commerce Business Person of the Year in 2010 and spent five years volunteering as an OLLI instructor at the University of Cincinnati and University of Dayton. He is also the former host of “Straight Talk-Clear Decisions.”

Away from work, Rik and his wife, Kim, are part of a blended family with five children and five grandchildren. He enjoys pickleball, golf, biking, motorcycling, boating, and bringing family and friends together at their lake house.

Name: Robert Barone
Intro description: My name is Robert, and I’ve been in the financial space for over 50 years. With a Ph.D. in Economics from Georgetown, my career has spanned co-founding an investment advisory firm, teaching Finance at the University of Nevada, serving as the CEO of a community bank, contributing to Forbes Markets as a writer, and serving as a Principal Wealth Manager. I’m dedicated to providing clients with an extensive understanding of the global markets and macroeconomic trends.
Full description: Dr. Robert Barone, Ph.D. is an economist whose storied career spans numerous decades and positions within the world of finance. Since gaining his Ph.D. in Economics from Georgetown, he has been a Professor of Finance (University of Nevada), a community bank CEO (Comstock Bancorp), and a Director of the Federal Home Loan Bank of San Francisco, where he served as its Chair in 2004. He lives and breathes the world of finance, continuing to provide clients and avid Forbes readers with his latest market insights.

Name: Ryan Austin
Intro description:
Hi 👋🏼 I’m Ryan. I’m a financial advisor based in Syracuse, Indiana, and the founder of Green Heron Wealthways. I work with small business owners, people approaching or living in retirement, widows and widowers, and individuals navigating an inheritance or other significant financial transition.

My background in philosophy and theology influences the way I approach financial planning. I ask thoughtful questions to understand not only the numbers, but also the values, priorities, concerns, and aspirations behind them. From retirement income and investment management to estate considerations and charitable giving, I help clients connect the different pieces of their financial lives and make informed decisions about what comes next.
Full description:
Ryan Austin is a CFP® professional and founder of Green Heron Wealthways, based in Syracuse, Indiana. His path into financial services began after graduating magna cum laude from Huntington University in 2012, where he studied philosophy and theology.

Growing up in Grand Rapids, Michigan, Ryan learned about hard work and service firsthand. His father became a general contractor while Ryan was in middle school, and Ryan spent years working alongside him. That experience gave Ryan an early appreciation for the responsibility that comes with running a business and the importance of doing work with integrity.

After college, Ryan entered the financial services industry through life, health, and long-term care insurance. He later moved into leadership, training and developing other professionals before obtaining his securities licenses and expanding the scope of his work with clients. In 2021, he shifted his focus fully toward serving clients and earned his CFP® certification. He later pursued the WMCP® and RICP® designations to deepen his knowledge of wealth management and retirement income planning.

Today, Ryan works with people facing a range of financial decisions, including retirement transitions, business ownership, inherited assets, investment management, charitable giving, estate considerations, healthcare costs, and Social Security. His approach combines technical planning with the curiosity that grew from his study of philosophy. He wants to understand the person behind the financial plan and what they want their resources to accomplish.

Ryan and his wife, Emily, married in 2017 and made their home in Syracuse. They welcomed their daughter, Sylvia, in December 2024. Through Green Heron Wealthways and Savvy, Ryan is building the independent advisory practice he envisioned for his community.

Name: Ryan Bond
Intro description: Hi there 👋🏼 I'm Ryan, a senior financial advisor, and CERTIFIED FINANCIAL PLANNER™ at Savvy. With over eight years of experience in the field, I have worked with renowned firms like Morgan Stanley, Pennington Partners, Vanguard, and Personal Capital. Now, I am thrilled to be part of the dynamic Savvy team, where I have rapidly expanded my client portfolio. Grateful for the support of my colleagues, we work to ensure a seamless transition and onboarding processes for my clients.
Full description:
Ryan is a senior financial advisor and a CERTIFIED FINANCIAL PLANNER™ at Savvy. His journey into the financial advisory field began about eight years ago. Ryan initially launched his career as an intern at Morgan Stanley during my college years. Subsequently, he transitioned to a position at Pennington Partners, a smaller firm, where he managed SMA (Separately Managed Accounts) portfolios. He oversaw several hundred million dollars on their platform for a couple of years.

Ryan’s commitment to advancing his expertise led him to Vanguard, where he achieved the CERTIFIED FINANCIAL PLANNER™ (CFP®) designation. Over the next three years, Ryan worked as an advisor on their platform. More recently, he spent a couple of years with Personal Capital, which was later acquired by Empower. In the past three years, Ryan has had the privilege of serving as an advisor with both firms.

Now, he is thrilled to be a part of the Savvy team.

Name: Ryan Garland
Intro description: Hi 👋🏼 I’m Ryan. I help individuals, families, and business owners build plans that are designed to offer clear financial direction while empowering them to make the most of their resources and lead more fulfilling lives. With a hands-on approach, my goal is to create space for discussion with my clients to fully understand their values and aspirations. I focus on tax optimized strategies, as well as succession planning, estate and wealth transfer planning, and retirement income plans. Overall, I seek to help clients understand what’s possible and confidently prepare for the future.
Full description:
Ryan Garland is a CERTIFIED FINANCIAL PLANNER® with over 13 years of experience serving high-net-worth clients with complex financial needs. Ryan specializes in helping individuals and families prepare for tax-efficient retirements, business owners navigate growth and succession, and professionals manage equity compensation or concentrated stock positions. His expertise includes complex estate and wealth transfer planning, tax strategies to minimize lifetime income taxes, and designing sustainable, tax-efficient retirement income plans. Ryan’s tax-aware investment approach ensures clients keep more of what they earn when planning for the future.

What sets Ryan apart is his ability to foster meaningful conversations that uncover his clients’ true goals, values, and aspirations. He views financial planning as a noble calling and takes pride in building clear, personalized plans. For Ryan, the most rewarding part of his work is forming genuine connections with clients, often turning professional relationships into lasting friendships.

Name: Ryan Gibbs
Intro description:
Hi, I'm Ryan. I'm a Wealth Manager with Palladian Asset Management based in Midlothian, Virginia. I help clients with retirement planning, income planning, investment management, and strategies designed to help them avoid costly financial mistakes.

My approach is low pressure, clear, and personal. I believe clients should understand their plan, feel heard, and know that the person guiding them is genuinely invested in their success.
Full description:
Ryan Gibbs is a Wealth Manager with 19 years of experience helping clients organize their financial lives and prepare for retirement. His interest in the work grew after hearing from friends and family who were unsure whether they would ever be able to retire. That experience shaped his focus on clear planning, practical guidance, and helping clients avoid costly mistakes.

Ryan works with clients across age groups and financial backgrounds. He does not set a minimum dollar amount before investing his time and energy. Much of his work centers on wealth accumulation, retirement income distribution, 401(k) rollovers, pension decisions, Roth IRA planning, investment cost efficiency, and goal-based planning.

Ryan currently lives in Chesterfield, Virginia and works out of the Midlothian office. Outside of work, he spends as much time as possible improving his golf game.

Name: Ryan Meda
Intro description: I’m Ryan, a financial advisor from Kansas City, Kansas. I’m a CERTIFIED FINANCIAL PLANNER™ and Principal Wealth Manager who helps professionals, business owners, and families build tax-efficient, coordinated wealth strategies. My approach goes far beyond managing investments— I focus on aligning tax, estate, and business planning to simplify complexity and create lasting financial freedom.
Full description:
Ryan Meda is a CERTIFIED FINANCIAL PLANNER™ and Principal Wealth Manager who helps professionals, business owners, and families build tax-efficient, coordinated wealth strategies. His approach goes far beyond managing investments—he focuses on aligning tax, estate, and business planning to simplify complexity and create lasting financial freedom.

With more than 10 years of experience, Ryan has guided clients through major financial transitions such as tax-optimized portfolio management, RSU vesting, trust and estate planning, and small-business strategy. He built his practice by blending institutional-level financial planning with a boutique, family-office experience offering the sophistication of large-firm resources with the personal attention of a trusted, long-term advisor.

A lifelong golfer, Ryan attended Mississippi State University, where he was part of the PGA Professional Golf Management (PGM) program. Originally from St. Louis, Missouri, Ryan now resides in Lenexa, Kansas. Ryan and his wife recently welcomed their first child, a son, in August 2025. He loves to travel, hike, and be outdoors. He has a passion for fitness, health, and wellness—values he brings into his work, helping clients live balanced, intentional lives.

Name: Sam Saleh
Intro description: Hi, I’m Sam, a wealth manager in Newport Beach, California. I’m passionate about helping individuals, families, and business owners with their investment, retirement, tax, estate, and small business succession planning. As a fiduciary Chartered Financial Consultant (ChFC®), I hold myself to the highest standard of excellence in financial planning and guidance for my clients.
Full description:
Sam Saleh is an experienced financial advisor, wealth manager, and seasoned entrepreneur with a diverse career spanning the financial services, construction, interiors and luxury furniture sectors. Currently, Sam leverages his extensive experience to provide comprehensive financial planning and wealth management services to high-net-worth individuals and families.Before transitioning into the financial advisory space, Sam was the CEO of a leading interior fit-out company, overseeing business growth, strategic direction, and operational management. He also founded a luxury interior & furniture company, gaining significant experience in funding, scaling, and exiting businesses.

Sam began his career with wirehouse & insurance firms like Merrill Lynch and New York Life, where he developed specialized skills in financial and risk management planning. During his tenure at these firms, Sam honed his expertise in investment strategies, insurance solutions, and wealth preservation for high-net-worth clients. His work in these areas laid the foundation for his current role as a trusted financial advisor and wealth manager.

Sam holds an MBA from California Polytechnic State University (Cal Poly) and a Chartered Financial Consultant (ChFC®) certification from the American College of Financial Services. His diverse education, combined with his broad business and financial experience, enables him to take a holistic approach to wealth management, focusing not only on financial growth, but also risk mitigation and long-term asset preservation.

With a passion for empowering clients to achieve financial security and success, Sam works closely with each client to develop tailored strategies that address their unique goals and challenges.

Name: Sandee Mapp
Intro description: Hi there! I’m Sandee Mapp, a Wealth Advisor from San Diego, California, specializing in holistic financial planning, portfolio management, and retirement planning. My passion for financial advising stems from the positive impact a financial advisor had on my life. After seeing close friends face financial complications from life’s unexpected events, I wanted to help others become more educated and strategic around their finances. For over a decade, I’ve had the privilege of guiding clients to build wealth intentionally and sustainably.
Full description:
Sandee’s journey into financial advising was deeply personal, inspired by the positive impact a good advisor had on her life. Sandee graduated from the University of San Diego with a Bachelor's of Business Administration with concentrations in finance and marketing. She also holds a Master's Certification in Project Management from George Washington University.

After years of success in financial services and consulting, unexpected layoffs prompted reflection on life's uncertainties. Witnessing her friends' face early retirement or career shifts underscored the importance of proactive financial planning. This motivated her to pivot into advising, focusing on helping others gain clarity, confidence, and security—especially during life’s transitions.

Over the past 11 years, Sandee has been privileged to guide clients, particularly women and those in underserved communities, in building wealth intentionally and sustainably, so they can navigate change with peace of mind. Sandee loves her clients and utilizes a holistic approach to retirement planning. Her plans focus on income planning, investment management, tax optimization planning, health and long-term care planning, and estate planning while realizing that “Life Happens.”

When Sandee is not working, she enjoys spending time with family and friends. She actively supports many local youth sporting and non-profit organizations.

Name: Sara Gelsheimer
Intro description:
Hi 👋🏼 I’m Sara. My goal as a financial advisor is to empower my clients to take control of their financial future with clarity, confidence, and a plan that aligns with their real lives, not just the numbers. While I love a good spreadsheet, I also focus on understanding my clients’ goals and making complex financial decisions easy to navigate. I value building deep relationships with clients while incorporating behavioral finance in my practice.

‍

Name: Scott Eichler
Intro description:
Hi there 👋 I'm Scott. I help Southern California property owners defer the tax on a property sale, without forcing them into a rushed 1031 exchange, or a property they don't want to manage.

I specialize in 1031 exchanges, Delaware Statutory Trusts (DSTs), and Qualified Opportunity Zones for real estate owners across Los Angeles, Orange County, San Diego, and the Inland Empire. Realtors and CPAs also send clients my way when a transaction has tax issues, lending problems, or a client that wants to sell and wants to stop managing property.
Full description: Scott Eichler is a financial advisor based in Southern California, specializing in 1031 exchanges, Delaware Statutory Trusts, and tax-deferred real estate transactions. Over nearly two decades in wealth management, he's built a practice around helping property owners across Los Angeles, Orange County, San Diego, and the Inland Empire navigate a sale without a rushed exchange or a property they don't want. Realtors and CPAs regularly refer clients to Scott when a transaction raises a tax question outside their own scope. His practice, Standing Oak Advisors, gives clients tools to see their numbers and their options before they ever get on a call: a calculator that estimates what they'd owe, and a decision tree that narrows down which strategy fits.

Name: Scott Jensen
Intro description: Hi there👋🏼 I'm Scott, a wealth advisor with over 13 years of experience, where I specialize in helping my clients with tracking and analyzing rental property portfolio performance, optimizing your taxes on property sales, and creating tailored financial plans through a personalized series of meetings. I love simplifying complex financial situations and building strong relationships with my clients to provide investment management that helps my clients achieve their goals.
Full description:
Scott Jensen, Founder of Renovate Financial Planning, powered by Savvy Wealth, is dedicated to helping real estate investors, small business owners, and high-income professionals achieve their financial goals with clarity and confidence. With a finance degree and seven years at a Minneapolis advisory firm, Scott launched his practice to address the unique needs of real estate investors. His expertise spans cash flow management, retirement planning, real estate and alternative investments, tax strategies, insurance, estate planning, and charitable giving. Scott’s tailored strategies, including rental portfolio analysis, tax-efficient real estate transactions, and passive investment transitions, ensure clarity and success.

Scott’s client-centric approach begins with an introductory call and discovery meeting, followed by a customized financial plan. When not helping clients navigate complex financial landscapes or researching tax strategies, Scott enjoys outdoor adventures with his wife and three daughters, or relaxing by the fireplace with coffee.

Name: Sean O’Connor
Intro description: Hi there! I’m Sean O’Connor, a Wealth Advisor from San Diego, California, specializing in income planning, tax management, life transitions, and other strategies for clients approaching or in retirement. My client's trust means everything to me. Whether it's cheering on their successes or counseling them during difficult periods, I love helping people navigate the complexity of financial decision-making.
Full description:
Sean O’Connor is a Wealth Manager in San Diego, California, well-versed across retirement planning, investment risk management, tax optimization, legacy planning, and other strategies for pre-retirees and retirees.

In 2008, Sean graduated from the University of Southern California with a degree in Economics. His career began supporting his parents’ retirement planning advisor, whose business was growing. During the financial crisis, Sean witnessed firsthand that individuals with a plan generally had better outcomes compared to others who didn’t have a plan and let emotions drive financial decisions. This experience solidified Sean’s approach as a voice of reason in times of uncertainty by simplifying the complexities around financial decision-making.

Outside of work, Sean is happily married with four children. He also loves staying active by hiking, mountain biking, playing beach volleyball, skiing, and playing classical piano.

Name: Stanford McCullough
Intro description: I’m Stanford McCullough, JD, LL.M, CFP®, an advisor at Blue Barn Wealth who specializes in tax planning, estate and wealth transfer strategies, philanthropic planning, and asset management for families and entrepreneurs.
Full description:
Stanford McCullough, JD, CFP®, specializes in income tax planning, wealth transfer and estate planning, philanthropic planning, and asset management for families and entrepreneurs.

Stanford earned his law degree from the S.J. Quinney College of Law at the University of Utah and later completed an LL.M. in Taxation from the University of California, Irvine. He currently serves as Treasurer/Secretary of the Tax Section of the Utah State Bar.

He earned his bachelor’s degree from Utah Valley University in Personal Financial Planning, with a minor in Business Management, and became a CERTIFIED FINANCIAL PLANNER™ professional during his undergraduate studies.

By combining his CFP® designation with advanced legal training in taxation, Stanford helps clients navigate complex financial decisions with clarity—especially when taxes, investments, and long-term legacy planning intersect.

Outside of work, Stanford enjoys spending time with his wife skiing, mountain biking, scuba diving, canyoneering, and playing sports.

Name: Stephanie Gumm
Intro description:
Hello 👋🏼 I’m Stephanie. I endeavor to help women, small business owners, dentists, and executives plan and achieve their dreams through thoughtful financial strategies. From retirement income and business planning to tax strategies and portfolio analysis, I focus on aligning your finances with what matters most to you.

I take an educational approach to my practice, guiding clients through complex decisions and ensuring they understand their options so they can make confident, intentional choices for their future. With over 25 years as a business owner myself, I aim to bring a real-world perspective to helping clients plan for every stage of life, including business exits, retirement, and long-term financial security.
Full description:
Stephanie Gumm is a seasoned financial advisor and business owner with over 25 years of experience helping clients achieve their financial goals. She is passionate about guiding women, small business owners, executives, and dentists through comprehensive financial planning, retirement income strategies, business planning, tax planning, and portfolio analysis. Stephanie is committed to aligning her clients’ strategies with their values, dreams, and long-term goals, ensuring that every recommendation is purposeful and actionable.

Stephanie brings a unique perspective to her clients, shaped by her own family experience. Raised in Baltimore with a private school education and summers spent at Rehoboth Beach, she witnessed firsthand the challenges families face when retirement and long-term planning are overlooked. This experience fuels her passion for educating clients and helping them confidently navigate their financial journey. For her business-owner clients, Stephanie begins each engagement with a thorough exit strategy, ensuring the business and personal financial goals are aligned for a successful transition in the future.

Outside of her professional life, Stephanie is deeply committed to her community. She serves as Vice Chair of the Board at Dandelion Meadow, supporting women who are victims of addiction and human trafficking, and she helped found the Love For Children outreach program through St. Paul’s Episcopal Church. She enjoys gardening, hiking, traveling, and spending time in the Virginia mountains with her husband and twin children.

Name: Steve Grogan
Intro description: Hi, I’m Steve Grogan. My engineering background trained me to think systematically, analyze complex problems, and design efficient solutions — skills that translate well into financial planning. I work with clients to cut through noise, focus on what matters most, and develop practical strategies that are grounded in their priorities.
Full description:
Steve Grogan brings the precision of an engineer and the perspective of a seasoned financial advisor to every client relationship. With over a decade of experience in financial planning, Steve works with professionals—especially those in engineering and technology—who value structure, clarity, and a methodical approach to their finances.

His process is centered on simplicity and collaboration: Organize, Explore, Execute. Clients appreciate his straightforward approach and the way he translates complex concepts into understandable, actionable guidance.

Name: Steve Holdsworth
Intro description: I'm Steve Holdsworth, a CERTIFIED FINANCIAL PLANNER® professional and fee-only fiduciary with over 30 years in financial services. I partner with my clients to help them design and simplify their financial lives in an increasingly complex world. Through holistic planning, wealth management, and tax-efficient strategies, I work to help you achieve financial wellbeing.
Full description:
Steve Holdsworth is a CERTIFIED FINANCIAL PLANNER® professional, and, as a fiduciary, committed to putting his clients' best interests first. With over 30 years in financial services and 23 years specifically in wealth management, he has helped individuals and families meet their personal financial goals. As a Wealth Manager in partnership with Savvy, Steve works with clients to design and simplify their financial lives in an increasingly complex world.

Before partnering with Savvy, Steve spent 14 years serving wealth management clients on behalf of one of Memphis' largest independent, fee-only Registered Investment Advisors, where he earned the title of Partner and Managing Director. After relocating to the Pacific Northwest, he served as Lead Advisor, Senior Financial Planner, and Financial Advisor for three Seattle-based Registered Investment Advisors. Steve has also served as a CFP® Certificate Program Adjunct Faculty member at Christian Brothers University.

Steve specializes in holistic financial planning, retirement cash flow planning, tax optimization, estate and trust planning, investment management, and protection planning. He works primarily with high net worth, affluent, and emerging affluent clients, particularly those in transition such as individuals approaching retirement, retirees, executives in the tech industry, and business owners. His approach is to lead with holistic planning to help clients achieve, maintain, and live what's most important to them through financial wellbeing.

Steve holds a Bachelor of Business Administration degree in Finance from the University of Texas and an MBA in Financial & Estate Planning from the University of Dallas.
