He has held the Chartered Life Underwriter® certification as well as FINRA Series 6, 63, 7, 66, and SIE licenses. Outside of work, Steve loves spending time with his family and exploring the Pacific Northwest, including camping, hiking, kayaking, biking, and playing golf.

Name: Steve Marcou
Intro description: My name is Steve Marcou, and I’m a financial advisor based in Indianapolis, Indiana. Beyond helping retired professors achieve their financial goals, I’m passionate about educating my clients about everything that impacts their financial outlook. Whether it’s financial planning, tax-efficient investment strategies, or mutual funds/ETFs, I enjoy sharing my expertise with clients and helping them enjoy retirement with confidence.
Full description:
Steve Marcou is a Wealth Manager with nearly two decades of experience as a financial advisor. His journey to becoming a financial advisor was inspired by his own experience using one. Seeing the value financial advisors provide in helping others achieve their financial goals, Steve wanted to do the same.

He began his career in 2006 at AXA Advisors working with insurance companies for four years and then in banking four years after. Having worked through three bear markets over his nearly double-decade career, Steve has a wealth of knowledge in navigating markets and helping retirees manage their assets.

Most recently, he worked at TIAA where he built a passion for working with retired professors managing their 403(b) accounts. Outside of work, Steve is huge on family, friends and his faith. He loves to spend time with his four children. He also loves to stay active and is a big sports fan, with rooting interests for the Cincinnati Reds, Cincinnati Bengals, and the Ohio State Buckeyes.

Name: Steve Meier
Intro description:
Hello 👋🏼 I’m Steve. I specialize in investment management, retirement planning, and portfolio strategies tailored to help individuals, families, and small business owners achieve their goals. Many of my clients are saving for retirement or their children’s education, while others are already in retirement, focused on protecting their wealth and creating a reliable income stream. I also partner with business owners to design and manage workplace retirement plans that support both them and their employees.

My approach is methodical and personalized, ensuring every plan reflects each client’s unique needs. At the heart of my work is building lasting relationships and helping people move forward with confidence.
Full description:
Steve works with individuals, families, and business owners in the areas of financial planning, investment and portfolio management, and retirement services. His primary clients are those saving for their retirement and their children’s education, as well as those in retirement working to both protect their investments and generate a consistent retirement income stream. Steve also works extensively with small business owners and their employees to design, implement and manage workplace retirement plans.

Steve is a 1986 graduate of Bowling Green State University with a Bachelors in Communications. He also graduated from Wheaton College Graduate School in 1990 with a Masters in International Relations. His credentials from the American College for Financial Services include the Accredited Asset Management Specialist (AAMS) designation and the Chartered Retirement Planning Counselor (CRPC) designation.

Steve is passionate about international missions and has traveled to 30 countries, often in the role of providing aid and relief services. His past experience includes working with the International Red Cross and the US government response team for domestic disasters.

Steve resides in Fishers, Indiana with his wife, Susan, and together they have five children and 4 grandchildren. Steve and Susan enjoy traveling and gardening and Steve is an avid hiker and adventurer, including summiting Kilimanjaro, hiking to Everest Base Camp, and traversing the Grand Canyon.

Name: Steven Harp
Intro description:
Hi, I’m Steven. As the Founder and CEO of Colorado Wealth Group, my vision is to make a positive impact on the community by serving as a true fiduciary to our clients and their goals. We focus on personalized financial planning designed to help our clients navigate life’s decisions with confidence and purpose.
My approach centers on building long-term relationships, simplifying complex financial topics, and creating strategies that align with what matters most to each client.
Full description:
Steven Harp is the Founder and Chief Executive Officer of Colorado Wealth Group. He graduated from the University of Missouri in 2004 and has since built a robust advisory practice grounded in fiduciary responsibility, education, and personalized service.

Steven is a CERTIFIED FINANCIAL PLANNER® professional and holds several advanced industry designations, including ChFC®, CLU®, AIF®, and CLTC®. These credentials allow him to deliver comprehensive advice across investments, retirement planning, tax planning, insurance, estate considerations, and long-term care strategies.

In addition to serving clients, Steven is passionate about continuing education and mentoring, helping develop advisors within Colorado Wealth Group to ensure consistent, high-quality client experiences.

Name: Susan Jones
Intro description:
Hi 👋🏼 I’m Susan. With over 25 years in wealth management, specializing in estate planning and tax strategy, I turn technical expertise into practical guidance to empower clients through life transitions. My areas of expertise range from tax, estate and multi-generational wealth strategies to financial planning for life transitions. I love to work with clients who prefer a thoughtful, integrated approach to wealth management including helping women gain clarity, confidence, and control over their finances and future.

Name: Tim Hudson
Intro description:
Hi 👋🏼 I’m Tim. I’m a CERTIFIED FINANCIAL PLANNER™ with 20 years of experience helping individuals and families make sense of important financial decisions. I focus on financial planning, estate and trust planning, and supporting people through major life transitions, including widows, divorcees, business owners, and families facing difficult health circumstances.

My approach starts with listening. Financial decisions can feel especially complicated during periods of grief or change, so I take the time to understand what clients are going through, explain their options clearly, and create a financial plan that reflects what matters most to them.
Full description:
Tim Hudson, CFP® is a CERTIFIED FINANCIAL PLANNER™ with 20 years of experience helping individuals and families navigate important financial decisions. His interest in financial advising began close to home. His grandfather, aunt, and father all worked as financial advisors, giving Tim an early look at the impact thoughtful financial guidance could have on families.

That perspective became even more personal after his father passed away. Tim’s mother suddenly faced financial decisions she had never handled on her own, including questions about stocks and mutual funds. Helping her work through those decisions showed Tim how unfamiliar and overwhelming finances can feel when someone is also coping with loss. The experience continues to shape his patient, listening-first approach with clients today.

Tim works with a range of clients, with a particular focus on widows, business owners, and individuals and families dealing with estate considerations. His work includes financial planning, estate planning, and tax-related planning, with an emphasis on helping clients understand how different parts of their financial lives fit together.

Tim and his family call the Summerville, South Carolina area home. Outside of work, he enjoys golf, fitness endurance events, and spending time with family and friends.

Name: Tim J Dern
Intro description:
Hi, I’m Tim. I’m a wealth advisor based in Schaumburg, Illinois and part of Mana Financial, where we help people approaching retirement organize the many moving pieces that come with this stage of life.

My work focuses on retirement planning, income planning, Social Security, Medicare, investment management, alternative investing, and wealth transfer. I use an educational approach to help clients understand their options and build a retirement income plan designed around their goals, lifestyle, and needs.
Full description:
Tim Dern is a wealth advisor with 10 years of experience helping clients navigate retirement planning, income planning, Social Security, Medicare, wealth management, and wealth transfer.

Before becoming a financial advisor, Tim graduated from Indiana University and began his career as a high school teacher. He later owned several businesses and served as Chief Marketing Officer for a $700 million international company. That background helps him relate to entrepreneurs, corporate professionals, and working families as they prepare for retirement.

Tim has been married to his wife, Helen, for more than 40 years. Together, they have three children, Bryan, Natalie, and Kyle, along with eight grandchildren. Family is an important part of Tim’s life and shapes the care he brings to client relationships.

Name: Todd Juenger
Intro description:
I’m Todd, a financial advisor based in Vancouver, Washington, with over three decades of experience helping individuals, families, and business owners create financial clarity and confidence. I believe that great planning isn’t just about numbers - it’s about understanding what matters most to you and building a roadmap that supports your life today and your goals for tomorrow.

Whether you’re preparing for retirement, navigating investment decisions, or looking to strengthen your long-term financial strategy, I’m here to provide guidance, structure, and a partnership you can count on.
Full description:
My career spans more than 30 years across the retail and corporate sides of the investment industry. Throughout that time, I’ve always been driven by one overarching goal: helping people make smart, informed financial decisions that support the life they want to live.

As a lifelong resident of the Pacific Northwest, I’m grateful for the community and experiences this region has given me—from my education to my personal and professional life. Outside of work, you can find me fishing, scuba diving, traveling, or enjoying a round of golf. These hobbies keep me grounded and shape how I build financial plans that support a full, meaningful life.

Name: Tyson Lokke
Intro description: Hello there! 👋🏼 I’m Tyson Lokke, a Certified Financial Planner™ with nearly 15 years of experience helping high-net-worth clients navigate complex financial challenges. My career has taken me through firms like United Capital and Goldman Sachs, where I’ve honed my expertise in wealth visualization, strategic exits, and tax-efficient financial planning. I have a deep passion for working with golfers, caddies, and their families, simplifying multi-state planning issues so they can focus on what truly matters. I also specialize in helping small business owners, executives, and 401(k) sponsors optimize their financial strategies. I earned my bachelor’s degree in Business from the University of Nevada, Reno—an R1 Carnegie Research University—and completed my CFP® certification at Bryant University. When I’m not working, you’ll likely find me on the golf course, spending quality time with my family, or engaging with my local community.
Full description:
Tyson Lokke, is a Certified Financial Planner™ with nearly 15 years of experience helping high-net-worth clients navigate complex financial challenges. Throughout his career at firms like United Capital and Goldman Sachs, he has remained committed to delivering innovative financial solutions. He specializes in helping clients visualize their wealth, plan strategic exits, and maximize their financial potential while minimizing tax burdens. He has a deep passion for working with golfers, caddies, and their families, simplifying multi-state planning issues so they can focus on what truly matters. Tyson's expertise extends to small business owners, executives, and 401(k) sponsors, as well as leading financial planning and portfolio management initiatives at Goldman Sachs for Las Vegas and Reno/Tahoe.

Tyson earned his bachelor’s degree in Business from the University of Nevada, Reno—an R1 Carnegie Research University—and completed his CFP® certification at Bryant University.

Outside of work, you can find Tyson on the golf course, spending quality time with his family, or actively engaging in his local community.

Name: Zack Smith
Intro description:
Hi, I’m Zack. I work with business owners, professionals, and long-term focused investors who want a disciplined approach to wealth building, retirement planning, and portfolio construction.

I bring a background in economics and political science education, and I’m passionate about clear communication and structured planning. I help clients build portfolios with risk-aware processes and integrate modern tools, including cryptocurrency ETFs, when they fit the plan and the client’s goals.
Full description:
Zack Smith is an Investment Adviser Representative based in Macomb, Michigan with 9 years of wealth management experience. He started his career as a high school teacher specializing in economics and political science, which shaped how he communicates complex topics in a clear, practical way.

Today, Zack works with business owners, professionals, and investors who value structure, long-term thinking, and a risk-aware approach to building wealth. His work often centers on asset allocation, portfolio construction, and retirement planning, including helping clients evaluate regulated digital asset exposure through cryptocurrency ETFs within a diversified portfolio.

Zack’s approach is rooted in education, transparency, and ongoing partnership. He aims to give clients a process they can understand, a plan they can follow, and a portfolio framework designed to adapt as markets and life evolve.
